sa: यथारूपां यथावर्णां यथालक्ष्मवती च ताम्॥ अश्रौषं राघवस्याहं सेयमासादिता मया। विररामैवमुक्त्वा स वाचं वानरपुङ्गवः॥
en: I have at last got her. And such were the form, grace and the marks that Rāghava mentioned to me. Having said this, the foremost of the monkeys ceased.

sa: प्रकाशरूपस्तु यदा न शक्तस्तौ बाधितुं राक्षराजपुत्रः। मायां प्रयोक्तुं समुपाजगाम बबन्ध तौ राजसुतौ दुरात्मा॥
en: And when the son of the Rākşasa monarch felt himself incompetent to cope with them openly, then that impious one, resorting to illusion, bound those princes (by that means).

sa: स जातमन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रम स्थितः स्थिरः संयति दुर्निवारणम्। समाहितात्मा हनुमन्तमाहवे प्रचोदयामास शितैः शरैस्त्रिभिः॥
en: And growing enraged, (Aksa), staying calmly in the field, with concentrated soul, challenged Hanumān difficult to resist in conflict and of prowess worthy to witness, with three whetted shafts.

sa: तं न पश्यामहे लोके यो नः शरणदो भवेत्। राघवेणोपसृष्टानां कालेनेव युगक्षये॥ नास्ति नः शरणः किंचिद्भये महति तिष्ठताम्। दावाग्निवेष्टितानां हि करेणूनां यथा वने॥
en: We do not see any such being in the world who can afford us shelter. Rāghava has attacked us like to the fire of dissolution. There is no refuge for who have been stricken with fear as no help re.. hes the elephants in a forest best with fire.

sa: तथा तु तौ संयति संप्रयुक्तौ तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम्। बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुश्च भीमौ महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नसेतू॥
en: There upon those too armies of the monkeys and Räkşasas, being ready to engage in the encounter, began to roar like to two mighty oceans having their banks broken.

sa: न चैव मानुषं रूपं कार्य हरिभिराहवे। एषा भवतु नः संज्ञा युद्धेऽस्मिन्वानरे बले॥ वानरा एव नश्चिहूं स्वजनेऽस्मिन्भविष्यति। वयं तु मानुषेणेव सप्त योत्स्यामहे परान्॥
en: In this battle, the monkeys need not assume the forms of human being. And let this serve for a sign that the monkeys, in order to the recognition of our own forces, appear with their proper monkey-marks. We seven only shall battle with the foe in human shapes, viz.

sa: प्रववौ सुरभिर्गन्धो विमाने पुष्पके तदा। श्यामावदातास्तत्रान्याः काश्चित् कृष्णा वराङ्गनाः॥ काश्चित् काञ्चनवर्णाङ्गयः प्रमदा राक्षसालये।
en: And in the residence of the Rākşas, there were some wenches sable, yet exceedingly witching; and some were dark-hued; and the frames of some were of a golden brilliance.

sa: अथ सा वायुपुत्राय तं हारमसितेक्षणा।८१।। तेजो धृतिर्यशो दाक्ष्यं सामर्थ्य विनयो नयः। पौरुषं विक्रमो बुद्धिर्यस्मिनेतानि नित्यदा।॥ हनूमांस्तेन हारेण शुशुभे वानरर्षभः। चन्द्रांशुचयगौरेण श्वेताभ्रेण यथाचलः।८३॥
en: Thereupon the lotus-eyed (Sitā) conferred that upon the Wind god's son. And Hanuman, the foremost of monkeys, in whom perpetually exist, energy, forgiveness, fame, skilfulness, prowess, humility, tactics, manliness, valiance and intellect, appeared with that necklace like a mountain beautified with the rays of the moon and white clouds.

sa: आशंसते वै धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रो महाराज्यमसपत्नं पृथिव्याम्। तस्मिञ्छमः केवलं नोपलभ्यः सर्वं स्वकं मद्गते मन्यतेऽर्थम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra, with his son, hopes for an undisputed suzerainty over this world. Absolute peace therefore is unobtainable. Whatever wealth is under his possession he regards as belonging to himself.

sa: असकृच्चाप्यहं तेन त्वत्कृते पार्थ भेदितः। न मया तद् गृहीत् च पापं तस्य चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: I, too, O son of Pritha, was sought to be withdrawn from four side by that vicious one; but that evil counsel of his was not accepted by me.

sa: सर्वथा त्वक्षमं चैतद् रोचते च ममानघ। यत् त्वं पितरि भीष्मे च प्रणिपातं समाचरेः॥
en: It is proper by all means and my wish, too, that you should pay proper respects to him who is like a father to you, as also to Bhishma.

sa: इमां मे सोपमां वाचं शृणु सत्यामशाङ्कितः। तां श्रुत्वा श्रेय आदत्स्व यदि साध्विति मन्यसे॥
en: "To these truthful words of mine, illustrated by an example, listen without entertaining any doubt or suspicion and hearing that accept the moral if you think my story good.

sa: संजय उवाच राज्ञो मुखमुदीक्षन्ते पञ्चालाः पाण्डवै सह। युधिष्ठिरस्य भद्रं ते स सर्वाननुशास्ति च॥
en: Sanjaya said All the the Panchalas, along with the Pandavas, are looking up to the face of the king Yudhishthira and he, good betide you, rules over them all.

sa: स्थाता नः समये तस्मिन् पितेति कृतनिश्चयाः। नाहास्म समयं तात तच्च नो ब्राह्मणा विदुः॥
en: Truly believing that our father would not break that pledge of his towards us, did we not break, O sire, our own. The Brahmanas who accompanied us know this.

sa: विस्रब्धो भव राजेन्द्र न व्यलीकं द्विजोत्तमः। वसन् प्राप्स्यति ते गेहे सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O foremost of kings, rest assured of it. I am telling you truly that the best of Brahmanas dwelling in your house will not in any way be dissatisfied..

sa: यक्ष उवाच कोऽतिथिः सर्वभूतानां किंस्विद् धर्मं सनातनम्। अमृतं किंस्विद् राजेन्द्र किंस्वित् सर्वमिदं जगत्॥
en: The Yaksha said: Who is the guest of all the creatures? What is the eternal religion? O king of kings, what is Amrita? And what is this entire universe?

sa: यस्य बाहुबले तुल्यो न भूतो न भविष्यति। अतीव समरं दृष्ट्वा हर्षो यस्योपजायते॥ योऽजयत् सङ्गत्तान् सर्वान् ससुरासुरमानवान्। तादृशेन सहायेन कस्मात् स न विजेष्यते॥
en: None has been and none will be his equal in strength of arms. It is he only who takes delight on seeing a mighty encounter. Why should he not come off victorious, being aided by him who defeated all the celestials, the Asuras and the human beings, assembled together?

sa: फल्गु यच्च बलं किंचिद् यच्चापि कृशदुर्बलम्। तत् संगृह्य ययौ राजा ये चापि परिचारकाः॥
en: The few invalids that there were in the army and all those that were weak and powerless-taking all these the king went with those that served him as attendants.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच शतायुरुक्तः पुरुषः सर्ववेदेषु वै यदा। नाप्नोत्यथ च तत् सर्वमायुः केनेह हेतुना॥
en: Dhritarashtra said In all the Vedas, man is said to have a life of one hundred years. For what reason then do not all men attain to that age?

sa: दशरथ उवाच प्रीतोऽस्मि वत्स भद्रं ते पिता दशरथोऽस्मिते। अनुजानामि राज्यं च प्रशाधि पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Dasharatha said: My son, I am pleased with you. May you be blessed. I am your father Dasharatha. O foremost of men, I command you to govern your kingdom.

sa: त्वं हि देवेश्वरः साक्षात् त्वया देयो वरो मम। अन्येषां चैव भूतानामिश्वरो ह्यसि भूतकृत्॥
en: (Because) you are the very lord of the celestials. It is for you to confer boons on me as you are the creator and lord of all other creators.

sa: न हि ते विग्रहं वीराः कुर्वन्ति कुरुभिः सह। अविनाशेन लोकस्य काइक्षन्ते पाण्डवाः स्वकम्॥१४।
en: These heroes do not (want to) wage war with the son of Kuru. The sons of Pandu do not want (to get back) their own by ruining the world.

sa: त्यक्तं मे जीवितं राज्यं धनं सर्वं च पार्थिव। न जातु पाण्डवैः सार्धं वसेयमहमच्युत॥
en: I can sacrifice my life, my kingdom, my wealth, my everything, O king; but I cannot live in peace with the sons of Pandu, O you of unfading renown.

sa: त्रिगर्तान् मे पिता यातः शून्ये सम्प्रणिधाय माम्। सर्वां सेनामुपादाय न मे सन्तीह सैनिकाः॥
en: My sire has gone out to fight with Trigartas taking the entire army with him and leaving me alone in the empty city there are no soldiers for me.

sa: न्यायागतं राज्यमिदं कुरूणां युधिष्ठिरः शास्तु वै धर्मपुत्रः। प्रचोदितो धृतराष्ट्रेण राज्ञा पुरस्कृतः शान्तनवेन चैव॥
en: Let the son of Dharma Yudhishthira rule over the kingdom of the Kurus, obtained justly, led by Dhritarashtra and placing the son of Shantanu at the helm of affairs."

sa: प्रत्यक्षं च परोक्षं च गुणवादी विचक्षणः। उपजीवी भवेद् राज्ञो विषये योऽपि वा भवेत्॥
en: The person, who earns his livelihood through the favour of the king or lives in his dominion, if prudent, must eulogize him both in his presence and behind him.

sa: दुर्योधन यदाह त्वां पिता भरतसत्तमा भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपः क्षत्ता सुहृदां कुरु तद् वचः॥
en: Duryodhana, what your father, that best among the Bharatas, as also Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and the Kshatta have told your is the advice of your well wishers; follow that.

sa: यत् तु शक्यमिहास्माभिस्तान् वै संचिन्त्य पाण्डवान्। बुद्ध्या प्रयुक्तं न द्रोहात् प्रवक्ष्यामि निबोध तत्।।१०।
en: To search them through mean spies would not be the policy of a (really wise man.) Consulting with others we should decide what we should do towards the Pandavas.

sa: कर्मणाऽमी भान्ति देवाः परत्र कर्मणैवेह प्लवते मातरिश्वा। अहोरात्रे विदधत् कर्मणैव अतन्द्रितो नित्यमुदेति सूर्यः॥९
en: Elsewhere (i.e. in the other world) the gods are resplendent through work, the wind blows through work. Causing day and night, through work, the sleepless sun rises every day.

sa: पार्थिवेषु न सर्वेषु य इमे तव सैनिकाः। यत् पापं यन्नकल्याणं सर्वं तस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Not even in all these rulers of the earth who constitute your army combined is there the same wickedness and the want of righteousness as is rooted in him.

sa: भीष्मं शान्तनवं षष्ट्या राजानं च शतेन ह। कर्णं च कर्णिना कर्णे विव्याध परवीरहा॥
en: That slayer of hostile heroes pierced with six shafts Bhishma, the son of Shantanu and the king Duryodhana with hundred and Karna in the car with a bearded shaft.

sa: यमस्तु तं ततो बद्ध्वा प्रयातो दक्षिणामुखः। सावित्री चैव दुःखार्ता यममेवान्वगच्छत। नियमव्रतसंसिद्धा महाभागा पतिव्रता॥
en: Binding it thus, Yama proceeded towards the south; and weighed down with grief, the exalted Savitri also, devotedly attached to her husband and successful in her vow, followed him.

sa: न च रात्रौ सुखं शेते ससर्प इव वेश्मनि। यः कोपयति निर्दोष सदोषोऽभ्यन्तरं जनम्॥
en: He cannot sleep at night in peace, like one having a serpent in the room; who, being a guilty person himself, provokes other people against one who is innocent.

sa: पिता त्वां पातु सर्वत्र तपनस्तपतां वरः। येन दत्तोऽसि मे पुत्र दिव्येन विधिना किल॥
en: O son, may your father, the foremost of those that shed heat and by whom you have been begotten on me by the ordinance of Destiny preserve you everywhere.

sa: सुभगा खलु कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते। कुतो हि तव सौभाग्यं यस्याः पुत्रो न राज्यभाक्।।१८।
en: It is indeed Kausalya who is fortunate in as much as her son will be installed. Where is your good fortune since your son will not obtain the kingdom?

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदश्चैव समन्युरिदमब्रवीत्। न धर्मधनसौख्येन नैश्चर्येण न चाज्ञया॥ नैव भोगैश्च मे कार्यं मा वहन्यत गच्छत। निश्चितेयं मम मतिः स्थिता प्रायोपवेशने॥ गच्छध्वं नगरं सर्वे पूज्याश्च गुरवो मम।
en: Having heard all that his friends said, he thus again spoke in sorrow, "I have nothing more to do with virtue, wealth, friendship, affluence, sovereignty and enjoyments. Do not oppose me; leave me all of you. I am firmly resolved to abandon my life by fasting. Go back to the city and worship all my Gurus with respect."

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच विद्यते मे न गाङ्गेय भयं देवासुरेष्वपि। समस्तेषु महाबाहो सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Duryodhana said No fear exists in me, O son of Ganga, froin even the gods and Asuras united together, O you of long arm, I tell you this truly.

sa: द्रोणो द्रौणिः कृपः शल्यः कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। परिवार्य चमूं सर्वां प्रययुः शिबिरं प्रति॥
en: Drona and his son, Kripa and Shalya and Kritavarma of the Satvata race, bringing up the rear of the hole host of the Kurus, wended towards their respective tents.

sa: एकैकस्तु ततः पार्थं राजन् विव्याघ पञ्चभिः। स च तान् प्रतिविव्याध द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां पराक्रमी॥
en: Then, O monarch, each of them separately pierced the son of Pritha with five shafts; and the puissant Partha in return pierced them each with a couple of arrows.

sa: एषोऽर्जुनो रणे भीष्मं प्रयाति कुरुनन्दनः॥ अभ्यद्रवत मा मैष्ट भीष्मो हि प्राप्स्यते न वः।
en: “You delighter of the Kurus Arjuna himself is rushing towards Bhishma. Rush you then upon the latter, and be not afraid. Bhishma will never be able to assail you.

sa: शिरसा ते दिवं व्याप्तं बाहुभ्यां पृथिवी तथा। जठरं ते त्रयो लोकाः पुरुषोऽसि सनातनः॥
en: The heavens are pervaded with your head; you does sustain the Earth with your two arms the triune world is inside your abdomen you are the Eternal Male being.

sa: इमां चाप्यपरां भूयः प्रतिज्ञां मे निबोधत॥ यद्यस्मिन्त्रहते पापे सूर्योऽस्तमुपयास्यति। इहैव सम्प्रवेष्टाऽहं ज्वलितं जातवेदसम्॥
en: Now listen to another oath of mine. If tomorrow's sun sets before I succeed in slaying this sinful wretch, then even here shall I enter into a blazing fire.

sa: रामाद् रामं जगदभूद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति। चतुर्विधाः प्रजा रामः स्वर्गे नीत्वा दिवं गतः॥
en: While Rama ruled his kingdom, the world became most charming and captivating. At last taking his subjects belonging to all the four orders with him, Rama ascended to heaven.

sa: एतत् तु रोचतां वाक्यं यदुक्तोऽसि मयानघ। एतत् क्षेममहं मन्ये तव चैव कुलस्य च॥
en: Let these words, O sinless one, uttered by me, be agreeable to you. This conclusion of peace do I consider to be beneficial to you and to your dynasty.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नैनं पश्यामि कौन्तेय यो मां युध्यन्तमाहवे। विजयेत पुमान् कश्चित् साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः॥
en: Bhishma said O son of Kunti, I do not see the person who, even if he be the lord of the celestial-can defeat me in battle when I fight.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं भीमसेनं यमौ च पार्थं कृष्णं युधि संजातकोपः। दुर्योधनः क्रोधविषो महात्मा जघान बाणैरनपलप्रकाशैः॥
en: Then the illustrious Duryodhana, having anger for his poison, waxing wrath in battle, wounded Yudhishthira, Bhima, Arjuna, and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) with arrows resplendent like fire itself.

sa: तथा पाण्डवसैन्यानि बभञ्ज युधि ते पिता। हतविद्रुतसैन्यास्तु निरुत्साहा विचेतसः॥ निरीक्षितुं न शेकुस्ते भीष्ममप्रतिमं रणे। मध्यंगतमिवादित्यं प्रतपन्तं स्वतेजसा॥ ते वध्यमाना भीष्मेण शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। कुर्वाणं समरे कर्माण्यतिमानुषविक्रमम्॥ वीक्षांचक्रुर्महाराज पाण्डवा भयपीडिताः। तथा पाण्डवसैन्यानि द्राव्यमाणानि भारत॥ त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त गावः पङ्कगता इव। पिपीलिका इव क्षुण्णा दुर्बला बलिना रणे॥
en: So your father also broke the Pandava ranks in battle. The soldiers thus routed, and despondent and cheerless, slain, by hundreds and thousands, by Bhishma, were unable to gaze at the incomparable Bhishma, who was scorching the foe like the sun in the meridian. The Pandava troops then afflicted with terror, O monarch, (fearfully) looked at Bhishma who was achieving great feats with his superhuman prowess. Then, O Bharata, the Pandava troops thus crushed by Bhishma, could not find a protector, like kine sunk in slough, or like an ephemeral ant afflicted by a powerful creature.

sa: तस्माद् राजन् स्थिरो भूत्वा प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत्। शृणु युद्धं यथावृत्तं शंसती मे नराधिप।॥
en: O monarch, through overwhelmed with this calamity, be still patient, and listen to the account of the battle as it happened, as I, O sire, go on recounting it.

sa: अथ रक्षा न मे संख्ये क्रियते कुरुनन्दन। अनुजानीहि मां राजन् गमिष्यामि गृहान् प्रति॥
en: On the other hand, O delighter of the Kurus, if you do not undertake to protect me in battle, permit me, O king, to go back to my home.”

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरा गीतः श्लोकोऽयं भरतर्षभ। प्रह्लादेनाथ भद्रं ते हृते राज्ये तु दैवतैः॥
en: It is heard, O best among the Bharatas, that in days of old, Pralhada sang this Sloka on his kingdom being wrested by the gods. May you fare well.

sa: क्वं युद्धं क्वं च भोक्तव्यं युध्यस्व पुरुषो भव। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ गदामालिङ्ग्य भारत॥
en: Great however is the difference between dishes and war. Come, now, fight and be a man. You will be down on the field killed, embracing your mace, O Bharata.

sa: एवमेव च मां नित्यं ब्राह्मणाः संदिशन्ति वै। प्रतिश्रुत्य भवेद् देयं नाशा कार्या द्विजोत्तमे॥
en: The Brahmanas always taught me this. Having promised to make them a gift, the gift should be made. A superior Brahmana should never be disappointed in his expectations. an

sa: यथा यथा कर्मगुणं फलार्थी करोत्ययं कर्मफले निविष्टः। तथा तथायं गुणसम्प्रयुक्तः शुभाशुभं कर्मफलं भुनक्ति॥
en: Seeking the fruits of acts, whatever acts (Satvika or Rajasika or Tamasika) a person performs, the fruits, good or bad, that he actually enjoys are permeated by their nature.

sa: वक्ता श्रोता च वाक्यं च सदा त्वविकलं नृप। सममेति विवक्षायां तदा सोऽर्थः प्रकाशते॥
en: When the speaker, the hearer, and the words said, perfectly agree with one another in course of a speech, then does the sense or meaning come out very clearly.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स एवमुक्तो द्विपदां वरिष्ठो नारायणेनोत्तमपूरुषेण। जगाद वाक्यं द्विपदां वरिष्ठं नारायणं लोकहिताधिवासम्॥
en: Bhishma said "Addressed by Narayana, that foremost of beings, in these words, Narada, the foremost of men, then said these words to Narayana for the behoof of the world.

sa: इन्द्रस्तां दुःखितां दृष्ट्वा अब्रवीत् परुषं वचः। पुरा सुदुःसहं भद्रे मम दुःखं त्वया कृतम्॥
en: Indeed, though I was present, you did not invoke me with honours. I am that Indra, O you of wicked understanding! It is I with whom you sought hostilities.

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमां गाथां गीतां ययातिना॥ यो मर्त्यः प्रतिपद्येत आयुर्जीवितमात्मनः। यज्ञमेकान्ततः कृत्वा तत् संन्यस्य तपश्चरेत्॥
en: Regarding it is cited the following verse sung by Yayati-That mortal who would acquire life and longevity should, after having celebrated sacrifices with devotion, renounce them and practise penances.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अध्यात्मं नाम यदिदं पुरुषस्येह चिन्त्यते। यदध्यात्मं यथा चैतत् तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, what and of what nature is that which passes by the name of Adhyatma (spiritual) and which is laid down for ever person.

sa: तं हीनपर्णं पतिताग्रशाखं निशीर्णपुष्पं प्रसमीक्ष्य वायुः। उवाच वाक्यं स्मयमान एवं मुदा युतः शाल्मलिमुग्रशाखम्॥
en: Seeing him divested of top, branches, leaves and flowers, the Wind, filled with joy, smilingly said to that lord of the forest which had before such a huge appearance.

sa: शौनक उवाच कथं स भगवान् देवो यज्ञेष्वग्रहरः प्रभुः। यज्ञधारी च सततं वेदवेदाङ्गवित् तथा॥
en: Saunaka said is that illustrious god, viz., the powerful Narayana, who is a master of the Vedas and their branches, at once the doer and the enjoyer of sacrifices?

sa: कृतज्ञेन सदा भाव्यं मित्रकामेन चैव ह। मित्राच्च लभते सर्वं मित्रात् पूजां लभेत च॥
en: Every one should be grateful, and every one should try to do good to his friends. Everything may be got from a friend. Honours may be got from friend.

sa: ये चादौ ब्राह्मणाः सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा तपसा पुरा। ते भावयन्तः पृथिवीं विचरन्ति दिवं तथा॥
en: Those Brahmanas whom Brahman created at the beginning, succeeded through their penances in honouring not the Earth alone but the heaven also in which they moved about at pleasure.

sa: अचोद्यमानानि यथा पुष्पाणि च फलानि च। स्वं कालं नातिवर्तन्ते तथा कर्म पुरा कृतम्॥
en: Pristine acts develop their consequences in their own proper time even as flowers and fruits, without any outward efforts, never fail to appear when the proper season sets in.

sa: एकान्तिनां च का चर्या कदा चोत्पादिताविभो। एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: What are the practices of those practices begin? I have doubts on those subjects. Do you dispell them. Great is my curiosity to her you explain the several points.

sa: दशानां तनयस्त्वेको दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः। तस्य द्वे नामनी लोके दक्षः क इति चोच्यते॥
en: The ten Prachetasas had one son between them, viz., the Prajapati called by the name of Daksha. This last has two names in the world, viz., Daksha and Ka.

sa: त्वं चैवेमां यदा भुक्त्वा पृथिवीं त्यक्षसे पुनः॥ न शक्ष्यसि तदा शक्र नियन्तुं शोकमात्मनः।
en: As regards you. ( Shakra, it is clear that when you shall have, after enjoying the Earth, to leave her you will not be able to control your grief.

sa: अतिथिरुवाच उपदेशं तु ते विप्र करिष्येऽहं यथाक्रमम्। गुरुणा मे यथाख्यातमर्थतत्त्वं तु मे शृणु॥
en: The Guest said-For all that, O Brahmana, I shall try to instruct you duly. Listen to me as I recount to you what I have heard from my preceptor.

sa: उटजस्थस्तु तं विप्रः प्रत्युवाच सुदर्शनम्। अतिथिं विद्धि सम्प्राप्तं ब्राह्मणं पावके च माम्।।६४। अनया छन्द्यमानोऽहं भार्यया तव सत्तम। तैस्तैरतिथिसत्कारैर्ब्रह्मन्नेषाा वृता मया॥ अनेन विधिना सेयं मामर्छति शुभानना। अनुरूपं यदनान्यत् तद् भवान् कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: Then that Brahmana, who was within the hut, thus replied to Sudarshana Know, O son of fire, that a Brahmana guest has arrived, and though tempted by your wife with various other offers of welcome, I have, O best of Brahmanas, desired only her body and this fair lady is engaged in welcoming me with due rites! You can do whatever you think proper on this occasion.

sa: विकृत उवाच मयास्य दत्तं राजर्षे गृह्णीयां तत् कथं पुनः। काममत्रापराधो मे दण्डमाज्ञापय प्रभो॥
en: I made a gift to him, O royal sage! How can I take it back? If I am guilty in this, do you declare the punishment, O powerful one.

sa: छत्रादिषु विशेषेषु मुक्तं मां विद्धि तत्त्वतः। स त्वां सम्मन्तुमिच्छामि मानार्हा हि मतासि मे॥
en: Know that I am truly shorn of all vanity about my royal umbrella and sceptre. I wish to know you thoroughly. You are deserving, I think, of my respect.

sa: मणिभद्र उवाच प्रीतास्ते देवताः सर्वा द्विजस्यास्य तथैव च। भविष्यत्येष धर्मात्मा धर्मे चाधास्यते मतिः॥
en: Then Manibhadra said The gods are all pleased with you as also with this Brahmana. This one shall become a virtuous man. He shall devote his mind to virtue.

sa: उभे द्विरात्रिसंध्ये वै नाभ्यगात् स ममालयम्। तस्मान्न शुद्ध्यते भावो मम स ज्ञायतां सुहृत्॥
en: These two inornings and two nights have passed away, and he has not come to my house. My mind, therefore, is not in peace. You enquire after my friend.

sa: भीष्म उवाच गिरिशृङ्ग समारुह्य सुतो व्यासस्य भारत। समे देशे विविक्ते स निःशलाक उपाविशत्॥
en: Bhishma said. Having got upon the summit of the mountain, O Bharata, the son of Vyasa sat down upon a level place free from blades of grass and secluded.

sa: काष्ठा निमेषा दश पञ्च चैव त्रिंशत्तु काष्ठा गणयेत् कलां ताम्। त्रिंशत्कलश्चापि भवेन्मुहूर्ता भागः कलाया दशमश्च यः स्यात्॥ त्रिंशन्मुहूर्तं तु भवेदहश्च रात्रिश्च संख्या मुनिभिः प्रणीता। मासः स्मृतो रात्र्यहनी च त्रिंशत् संवत्सरो द्वादशमास उक्तः॥ संवत्सरं द्वे त्वयने वदन्ति संख्याविदो दक्षिणमुत्तरं च॥
en: The Rishis, measuring time, have given particular names to particular portions. Five and ten winks of the eye make what is called a Kashtha: Thirty Kashthas make what is called a Kala. Thirty Kalas, with the tenth part of a Kala, make a Muhurta. Thirty Muhurtas make up one day and night. Thirty days and nights form a month, and twelve months form a year. Persons well-read in mathematical science say that a year is made up of two solar motions. viz., the northern and the southern.

sa: केन दुःखेन संतप्ता रोदिषि त्वं वरानने। ब्राह्मणं तं ततो दृष्ट्वा सा स्त्री करुणमब्रवीत्॥
en: Two hundred sons of mine, O twiceborn one, have been killed by Time. I was formerly a king, O learned Brahmana and in that state had a hundred sons.

sa: तभेवंवादिनं पार्थ शिष्यं गुरुरुवाच ह। सर्वे तु ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्र वै संशयो द्विज॥
en: To that disciple, O son of Pritha, who said So, the preceptor said, O twice-born one, I shall explain to you everything about which you may have any doubts.

sa: स दिशः प्रदिशश्चैव पर्वतानि वनानि च। पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च विचिन्त्याथ मनोगतिः। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण बृहस्पतिमुपागमत्॥
en: Having searched in all countries and provinces, mountains and forest, the earth and the sky, with the speed of the mind, he in a moment came back to Brihaspati.

sa: तमसा संवृते लोके व्यद्रवत् सर्वतोमुखी। उत्सृज्य शतशो वाहांस्तत्र केचिन्नराधिपाः। प्राद्रवन्त महाराज भयाविष्टाः समन्ततः॥
en: Took to flight in all directions when the world was enveloped in darkness. Hundreds of kings, leaving their conveyances, fled away, O great monarch, in terror, on all side.

sa: तथाभवद्भ्या कार्यं स्यादित मे निश्चितामतिः। इत्युक्तवाप्राविशद् द्रौणिः पार्थानां शिविरं महत्॥ अद्वारेणाभ्यवस्कन्ध विहाय भयमात्मनः।
en: Having said so, the son of Drona entered the extensive camp of the Parthas. Shorn of fear, he entered into it by a spot where there was no door.

sa: मन्त्रिणः ऊचुः शृणु पार्थिव यद्भषे पितुस्तव महात्मनः। चरितं पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य यथा निष्ठां गतश्च सः॥
en: The Ministers said: Hear, O king, what you have asked. Hear an account of that king of the world, your illustrious father's life and how he left this world.

sa: गुहायां निहितानि त्वं मम रत्नानि पृच्छसि। यदा मे भविता कालस्तदा त्वं यानि द्रक्ष्यसि॥
en: Those valuable possessions of mine about which you ask are now buried in the darkness of a cave. When my time comes again, you will, forsooth, behold them again.

sa: न चोवाच स मेधावी तमथो साध्वसाधु वा। तस्थौ तथैव चाक्रुद्धः सर्प स्कन्धेन धारयन्॥
en: But that wise man did not speak a word, good or bad and he did not become angry. He remained as he was, bearing the snake on his shoulder.

sa: निष्क्रम्य शिविरात् तस्मात् ताभ्यां संगम्य वीर्यवान्॥ आचख्यौ कर्म तत् सर्वं हृष्टः संहर्षयन् विभो।
en: Having come out of thc encampinent, the brave Ashvatthaman met his two companions and, filled with joy, communicated to them his achievement gladdening them, O king, by the news.

sa: कथं च वो मनस्तात निवृत्तेष्वभवत् तदा। मामकानां च ये शूराः के कांस्तत्र न्यवारयन्॥
en: What also, O sire, was the state of your mind when they returned to the attack. What heroes of our army with stood them on the field of battle?

sa: ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः अस्मत्पोषणजा चिन्ता मा भूत् ते हृदि पार्थिव। स्वयमाहत्य चान्नानि त्वानुयास्यामहे वयम्॥
en: The Brahmanas said : O king, do not allow any anxiety for our maintenance to find a place in your heart. Procuring our food ourselves, we shall follow you.

sa: स्वार्थे सर्वे विमुह्यन्ति येऽपि धर्मविदो जनाः। तस्माद् राजन् ब्रवीम्येष वाक्यं ते यदि रोचते॥
en: Even persons, conversant with morality, are bewildered in their own interests. It is for this I tell you, O king, whether my words be acceptable to you or not.

sa: हते कर्णे कुरवः प्राद्रवन्त भयार्दिता गाढविद्धाश्च संख्ये। अवेक्षमाणा मुहुरर्जुनस्य ध्वजं महान्तं वपुषा ज्वलन्तम्॥
en: After Karna's fall the Kuru soldiers, wounded with arrows and filled with fear, took to their heels looking again and again on the lofty and shining standard of Arjuna.

sa: आगमिष्यन्ति राजानः सर्वे वै कौरवर्षभ। प्राप्तानां महतां पूजा कार्या ह्येतत् क्षमं हि नः॥
en: O chief of the Kauravas, many kings will come (to your sacrifice)! When they arrive, high honours should be paid to them. This would, indeed, be worthy for us.

sa: अग्निरुवाच नापः प्रवेष्टुं शक्ष्यामि क्षयो मेऽत्र भविष्यति। शरणं त्वां प्रपन्नोऽस्मि स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महाद्युते॥
en: The god of fire said I cannot enter the water there I am destroyed. I throw myself under your protection. O you of great luster, I wish you well.

sa: परित्यजति यो दुःखं सुखं वाप्युभयं नरः। अभ्येति ब्रह्म सोऽत्यन्तं न तं शोचन्ति पण्डिताः।१७।।
en: That man who renounces both joy and sorrow, is said to attain to Brahma. When such a man dies, men of wisdom never indulge in any grief for him.

sa: शेषं कुर्याद् गिरेर्वज्रो निपतन् मूर्ध्नि संजय। न तु कुर्युः शराः शेषं क्षिप्तास्तात किरीटिना॥
en: O Sanjaya, O child, even the thunderbolt, that falls on the mountain peak, leaves a portion unburnt, but the arrows, shot by Kirti (Arjuna) do not leave anything behind.

sa: धर्मं संहरते तस्य धनं हरति यस्य सः। ह्रियमाणे धने राजन् वयं कस्य क्षमेमहि॥
en: One who robs another of riches, robs him of his religion as well. Who amongst us, therefore, O king, would forgive an act of depriving us of our wealth.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा विध्यः शैल: सूर्यमथाब्रवीत्। यथा हि मेरुर्भवता नित्यशः परिगम्यते॥ प्रदक्षिणश्च क्रियते मामेवं कुरु भास्कर। एवमुक्तस्ततः सूर्यः शैलेन्द्र प्रत्यभाषत॥ नाहमात्मेच्छया शैलं करोम्येनं प्रदक्षिणम्। एष मार्गः प्रदिष्टो मे यैरिदं निर्मितं जगत्॥
en: Seeing this, the Vindhya inountain spoke thus to the sun, “As you every day go round Meru and honour him, O sun, so do you the sarne by going round me.” Having been thus addressed, the sun thus replied to that king of mountains. "O mountain, I do not walk round it out of my own desire. He who has created this universe has assigned this path to me.”

sa: अम्बरीष उवाच नृशंसत्यक्तधर्मोऽस्तु स्त्रीषु ज्ञातिषु गोषु च। निहन्तु ब्राह्मणं चापि यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Ambarisha said Let him who has stolen your stalks be cruel and sinful in his conduct towards women and kinsmen and kine! Let him be guilty also of Brahmanicide!

sa: जनमेजय उवाच केनानुशप्तास्ते वीराः क्षयं वृष्ण्यन्धका गताः। भोजाश्च द्विजवर्य त्वं विस्तरेण वदस्व मे॥
en: Crused by whom did those heroes, viz., the Vrishnis, Andhakas and the Bhojas, met with destruction? O foremost of twice-born persons, do you fully explain all this to me.

sa: तदपत्यं भवानस्तु मा भवान् दुष्कृतं पितुः। अति यत् तत् कृतं कर्म लोके धीरविगर्हितम्॥
en: Be you that (real) son (of the monarch). Do you not approve the action of your father, since what he has done is divorced from righteousness and is blameworthy.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच अस्वाध्यायपरो लोके श्वानं च परिकर्षतु। पुरे च भिक्षुर्भवतु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Vasishtha said Let him who has stolen your stalks neglect his Vedic studies, leash hounds, and having taken himself to the mendicani order live in a city or town.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सत्यवती दीना कृपणा पुत्रगृद्धिनी। पुत्रस्य कृत्वा कार्याणि स्नुषाभ्यां सह भारत॥ समाश्वास्य स्नुषे ते च भीष्मं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्। धर्मं च पितृवंशं च मातृवंशं च भाविनी। प्रसमीक्ष्य महाभागा गाङ्गेयं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥ शान्तनोधर्मनित्यस्य कौरव्यस्य यशस्विनः। त्वयि पिण्डश्च कीर्तिश्च संतानं च प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The unfortunate and miserable Satyavati, plunged in grief for her son, performed with her daughters-in-law the obsequial rites of her son. The amiable lady then consoled her two daughters-in-law and the foremost of all wielders of arms Bhishma; Then turning her mind on virtue and on the paternal and maternal lines, the illustrious lady thus addressed the son of Ganga. "The funeral cake, the achievements and the perpetuation of the Kuru dynasty and of the line of the illustrious and virtuous Shantanu all depend upon you.

sa: विनतोवाच श्वेत एवाश्वराजोऽयं किं वा त्वं मन्यसे शुभे। ब्रूहि वर्णं त्वमप्यस्य ततोऽत्र विपणावहे॥
en: Vinata said: This king of the horses is of white colour. What colour do you think, sister? Say what is its colour; let us lay a wager on it.

sa: यैः सायकैः सालवरा निकृत्ता बाली हतो वानरपुङ्गवश्च। ते कुम्भकर्णस्य तदा शरीरं वज्रोपमानं व्यथयांप्रचक्रुः॥
en: Those shafts which had severed the seven stately salas, and, to boot, had slain Vāli—best of monkeys, they resembling the thunder itselfcould not impart any pain to Kumbhakarņa's body.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच श्रुता मे जल्पतां तात पौराणामशिवा गिरः। त्वामनादृत्य भीष्मं च पतिमिच्छन्ति पाण्डवम्॥
en: Duryodhana said : o father, I have heard (the citizens) uttering words of ill-omen. Passing you and Bhishma by, they desire the son of Pandu to be their king.

sa: शिशुपाल उवाच स मे बहुमतो राजा जरासंधो महाबलः। योऽनेन युद्धं नेयेष दासोऽयमिति संयुगे॥
en: Shishupala said The greatly powerful king Jarasandha, who did not desire to fight with Krishna, saying that he was but a “servant”, was (surely) worthy of my greatest esteem.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मिंस्तु निहते शूरे शाल्वे समिति शोभने। तवाभज्यद् बलं वेगाद् वातेनेव महाद्रुमः॥
en: Sanjaya said After the heroic Shalya, that flower of the court, had been killed your ariny were dispersed like a huge tree broken by the force of the storm.

sa: ततयोः पदानुगान् हत्वा पुनः पञ्चाशतं रथान्। प्रत्यगाद् भारती सेनां निघ्नन् पार्थो वरान् वरान्॥
en: Then, having slain fifty car-warriors, the followers of those two princes, Pritha's son plunged into the army of the Bharatas, crushing down numerous elephants and warriors (at each step).

sa: राजा धर्मश्च कामश्च द्रव्याणां चोत्तमो निधिः। धर्मः शुभं वा पापं वा राजमूलं प्रवर्तते॥
en: The king is the virtue, the king is the desire and the king is the prime jewel of all subjects. Virtue, desire or sin-every thing ariseth from the king.

sa: कृतज्ञः कामरूपी च सहायार्थी च वीर्यवान्। शक्तौ ह्यद्य युवां कर्तुं कार्यं तस्य चिकीर्षितम्॥
en: Despise not that kingly monkey Sugrīva, because he is grateful, capable of assuming shapes at will, seeking protection and powerful. You too are able to accomplish his wished-for object.

sa: तन्न सिध्यति सौमित्रे तवापि भरतस्य वा। कथमिन्दीवरश्यामं रामं पदानिभेक्षणम्॥ उपसंश्रित्य भर्तारं कामयेयं पृथग्जनम्।
en: But your or Bharata's intention shall not be satisfied, O Saumitre. How shall I desire another man after serving the lotus-eyed Rāma of dark blue hue as my husband?

sa: किं नु दुःखमलीकं वा मयि रामे च पश्यसि। न कथंचिद्यते रामाद् भरतो राज्यमावसेत् ॥ रामादपि हि तं मन्ये धर्मतो बलवत्तरम्। कथं वक्ष्यसि रामस्य वनं गच्छेति भाषिते॥ मुखवणं विवर्णं तु यथैवेन्दुमुपप्लुतम्।
en: How have I and Rāma conspired against your happiness; and what offence do you find in us? Bharata will by no means accept the kingdom, depriving Rāma of it, for I consider Bharata a still more grounded in righteousness than Rāma himself. when I shall say, “Repair to the forest, and Rāma's countenance will fall, like to the moon overwhelmed by Rāhu, how shall I behold it?

sa: तस्मिन् क्षणेऽभीक्ष्णमवेक्षमाणः क्षितिक्षमावान् भुवनस्य गोप्ता। रामो रुदन्ती व्यसने निमग्नां समुत्सुकः सोऽथ ददर्श ताराम्॥
en: In the mean-time, Rāma patient like to the protector of the world, worked with curiosity looked again and again towards the bewailing Tārā sunk in the gulf of disaster.

sa: त्वयि वीर विपन्ने हि अज्ञानाल्लाघवान्मया। मौढ्यं च मम बाल्यं च ख्यापितं स्यात्कपीश्वर ॥
en: O hero, O lord of monkeys, if any disaster befalleth you, who are already overwhelmed with miseries, through my ignorance childishness, they shall be known all over the world.

sa: इथून मधूंस्तथा लाजान् मैरेयांश्च वरासवान्। पानानि च महार्हाणि भक्ष्यांश्चोच्चावचानपि॥ उष्णाढ्यस्यौदनस्यात्र राशयः पर्वतोपमाः। मृष्टान्यन्नानि सब्दलंश्च दधिकुल्यास्तथैव च॥ नानास्वादुरसानां च खाण्डवानां तथैव च। भोजनानि सुपूर्णानि गौडानि च सहस्रशः॥
en: And she produced sugarcanes, and honies, and fried rice, and excellent Maireyas, (A kind of wine prepared from molasses). A preparation of milk rice. and costly drinks, and various viands, and heaps of warm rice resembling hills, and other kinds of edibles, and soups, and Dadhikulyas, together with silver plates by thousands filled with meats of diverse tastes.

sa: तेषां स्वस्त्ययनं चैव महर्षिः स चकार ह। प्रस्थितान् प्रेक्ष्य तांश्चैव पिता पुत्रानिवौरसान् ॥
en: Seeing them about to set forth, that Maharși performed a propitiatory ceremony for them, even as a father does on behalf of the sons begot from his own loins.

sa: स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैः खङ्गाभ्यां च परिक्षतः। निष्पिष्टो बहुधा भूमौ न ममार स राक्षसः॥
en: Although he was sore pierced by full many an arrow and cut shortly by scimitars, and pressed down on the earth in various ways, yet the Rākşasa expired not.

sa: मृते मयि गते रामे वनं मनुजपुङ्गवे। इष्टे मम जने शेषे किं पापं प्रतिपत्स्यसे॥
en: And I having been dead and that best of men, Räma, having gone to the woods (I do not know) to what a plight you will bring my kindreds.

sa: यदि त्वं यास्यसि वनं त्यक्त्वा मां शोकलालसाम्। अहं प्रायमिहासिष्ये न च शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्॥
en: If do you depart to the forest leaving me troubled with sorrow, I shall resort to the vow of fasting and shall not be able to sustain my life.

sa: राज्ञस्तूपरते वाक्ये जनघोषो महानभूत्। शनैस्तस्मिन् प्रशान्ते च जनघोषे जनाधिपः॥ वसिष्ठं मुनिशार्दूलं राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।
en: When the king paused, there arose a mighty tumult from the multitude. And when it subsided, that lord of men, the king, addressed that foremost of ascetics, Vasiştha saying.

sa: मनश्च मे हतं भूयश्चक्षुः प्राप्य तु संश्रयम्। यत्नेन महता ह्यस्मिन् मनः संधाय चक्षुषी॥ यत्नेन महता भूयो भास्करः प्रतिलोकितः। तुल्यपृथ्वीप्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ॥
en: My mind, combined with my eyes waxed feebler. And then fixing with might and main my eyes as well as my mind (on the sun), I could by a violent exercise of my energy behold the sun. And the sun shining, appeared to us like the earth in extent.

sa: आबध्यन्तां पताकाश्च राजमार्गश्च सिच्यताम्। सर्वे च तालापचरा गणिकाश्च स्वलंकृताः॥ कक्ष्यां द्वितीयामासाद्य तिष्ठन्तु नृपवेश्मनः।
en: And do you set up flags, and water the high ways, and let courtesans whose profession is music, adorning themselves stay in the second apartment of the king's residence.

sa: अतोमूलाः क्रियाः सर्वा मम राजन् न संशयः। बहुना किं प्रलापेन न दास्ये कामदोहिनीम्॥
en: This, O king, is without doubt, the root of all my rites. And what need of dilating? This one bestowing everything that is desired will I not part with.

sa: न स संकुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः॥
en: The way that has been wended by the slain Vali, is not yet narrowed. Do you, O Sugriva, desist in time: do not walk in the wake of Vāli.

sa: रामस्य यदिदं कार्यं कर्तव्यं प्रथमं मया। जरया च हृतं तेजः प्राणाश्च शिथिला मम॥
en: And albeit age has deprived me of energy, and albeit my life hangs loosely on me, yet, if this is Rāma's work, it should be done by me first.

sa: मया चैव भवत्या च कर्तव्यं वचनं पितुः। राजा भर्ता गुरुः श्रेष्ठः सर्वेषामीश्वरः प्रभुः॥
en: “Proper it is both for you and me to carry out father's words” he is your husband, and my best preceptor and the lord and master of all people.

sa: तस्मात् पुत्र त्वमात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर। तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः॥ त्वारिताः शीघ्रमागत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन्।
en: Therefore, do you, O son, disciplining yourself thus address you to your task. Hearing this, Rāma's well wishers, ever doing his pleasure, speedily going out, acquainted Kausalyä with everything.

sa: ततः शूर्पणखावाक्यादुद्युक्तान् सर्वराक्षसान्। खरं त्रिशिरसं चैव दूषणं चैव राक्षसम्॥ निजधान रणे रामस्तेषां चैव पदानुगान्। वने तस्मिन् निवसता जनस्थाननिवासिनाम्॥ रक्षसां निहतान्यासन् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश।
en: It was while living there in the society of the inhabitants of Janasthāna, that Rāma slew in battle the Rākşasas Khara and Trisiras and Dusana, together with their followers, who all had been stirred up by the words of Śūrpanakhā. And fourteen thousand Räksasas were slain in that battle.

sa: ततस्तु तं पत्ररथं महीतले निपातितं रावणवेगमर्दितम्। पुनश्च संगृह्य शशिप्रभानना रुरोद सीता जनकात्मजा तदा।॥
en: Then Sītā the daughter of Janaka, having a moon-like countenance began lamenting, clasping with her hands Jațāyu, crushed and fallen on the ground by the vehemence of Rāvana's prowess.

sa: प्रसादितश्च वै पूर्वं त्वं में बहुतिथं प्रभो। गमनं वनवासस्य कासितं हि सह त्वया॥
en: I had requested you, O my lord, many times before in this house to take me to the forest with you for enjoyment, and you ware pleased to agree.

sa: क्व नु सा क्षुत्पिपासार्ता श्रान्ता शेते तपस्विनी। स्मरन्ती तस्य मन्दस्य कं वा साद्योपतिष्ठति॥
en: Where does lie that glorious one, oppressed with hunger and thirst and fatigued with toil; and always meditating upon that miserable one, to whom does she now attach herself?"

sa: नाराचानर्धनाराचाज्छस्त्राणि विविधानि च। एतद् दत्त्वा महद् द्रव्यं पूर्वदेशाधिपा नृपाः। प्रविष्टा यज्ञसदनं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Long and short arrows, and various other kinds of weapons such valuable things were presented by the eastern kings. They then entered the sacrificial palace of the illustrious Pandava.

sa: स्त्रिया मूढेन बालेन लुब्धेन लघुनापि वा। सर्वे चाराश्च न मन्त्रयीत गुह्यानि येषु चोन्मादलक्षणम्॥
en: In matters of secrecy, a woman, a fool, a boy, a covetous man, a mean-minded person and he in whom signs of insanity are marked must not be consulted.

sa: त्वं चापि तद् वेत्थधनंजयश्च पुन तायागतानां सभां नः। यन्माऽब्रवीद्धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्र एकग्लहार्थं भरतानां समक्षम्॥
en: When summoned again to the Sabha for playing once more, you as well as Arjuna know what the son of Dhritarashtra told me in the presence of the Bharatas.

sa: अयमर्थो न संवेद्यो भीमे मातः कदाचन। त्वत्संनिधौ नियोक्ष्येऽहं सुदेवं द्विजसत्तमम्॥ यथा न नृपतिर्भीमः प्रतिपद्येत मे मतम्। तथा त्वया प्रकर्तव्यं मम चेत् प्रियमिच्छसि॥
en: "O mother, let not king Bhima, by any means, know my object. I like to employ that foremost of the Brahmanas, Sudeva, in your presence. Should you desire my welfare, do you act in such a manner that king Bhima will not come to know this purpose of mine.

sa: नियतं तं विजेष्यामि कृत्वा तु कपटं विभो। आनयामि समृद्धिं तां दिव्यां चोपाह्वयस्व तम्॥
en: O lord, I shall always defeat him at every throw by practising deception. I shall win all.. his celestial-like wealth; and you will (then) be able to enjoy it.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच क्रोधो हन्ता मनुष्याणां क्रोधो भावयिता पुनः। इति विद्धि महाप्राज्ञे क्रोधमूलौ भवाभवौ॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Anger is the destroyer of mankind and anger again places them in prosperity; consider, therefore, O highly-intelligent lady, that anger is the root of prosperity and adversity.

sa: ते तं तदा तोमरपट्टिशाद्यैर्व्याविद्धशस्त्रैः सहसा निपेतुः। जिघांसवः क्रोधवशाः सुभीमा भीमं समन्तात परिवव्र रुग्राः॥
en: Thereupon they rushed upon him with great force upraising their lances, axes and other weapons. Desiring to kill Bhima, those dreadful and fearful Krodhavasas surrounded hiin on all sides.

sa: महता कालयोगेन प्रकृतिं यास्यतेऽर्णवः। ज्ञातीश्च कारणं कृत्वा महाराजो भगीरथः॥ पूरयिष्यति तोयौघैः समुद्र निधिमम्भसाम्।
en: A very long time must pass before the ocean would be able to resume its natural state by making the relatives of the great king Bhagiratha as its cause."

sa: जानीषे त्वं यथा राजा सम्यग् वृत्तः सदा त्वयि। तस्य त्वं रिषमस्थस्य साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: It is known to you how always you were treated by the monarch. Now it is necessary for you therefore, to remember this and help him in his distress.

sa: देवानामिव ते सर्वं वाचि बुद्धं न संशयः। स दीन इव दुर्धर्ष कस्माच्छोचसि पुत्रकः॥
en: All these certainly wait your command as do they in the case of the celestials. () invincible hero, O son, why do you grieve (then) like a destitute person?

sa: गङ्गोवाच किमिच्छसि महाराज मत्तः किं च ददानि ते। तद् ब्रवीहि नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि वचस्तव॥
en: Ganga said: O best of men, O great king, what do you desire? What should be given to you by me? Tell me, I shall do what you say.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच अस्ति ते वै प्रिया राजन् ग्लह एकोऽपराजितः। पणस्व कृष्णां पाञ्चालीं तयाऽत्मानं पुनर्जय॥
en: Shakuni said O king, there is still one stake dear to you which is not yet won. Bet Krishna, (Draupadi), the princess of Panchala. By her, win yourself back.

sa: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य वयं सर्वे महात्मनः। मन्यामहे जिताना तौ परान् प्राप्ता च मेदिनीम्॥
en: Relying upon the strength of arms of that illustrious hero, we can take for granted that our enemies are already vanquished and the possession of the earth is ours,

sa: मया प्रशमिते पश्चात् त्वमेष्यसि वनात् पुनः। एवं कृते न ते दोषा भविष्यन्ति विशाम्पते॥
en: The enemies thus being slain by me, you may come back to the forest again, O king of kings, there will be no fault of yours if thus acted.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच निवार्याथ ततः पार्थं सर्वे देवा यथागतम्। जग्मुरन्ये च ये तत्र समाजग्मुर्नरर्षभ॥
en: O the most exalted of mortals, having prevented Arjuna (from hurling these weapons), all the celestials and all other beings who had come there went to their respective abodes.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एवमाहायमसितो देवलो मुनिसत्तमः। इमानि लोकद्वाराणि यो वै भ्राम्यति सर्वदा॥ इदं वै देवनं पापं निकृत्या कितवैः सह। धर्मेण तु जयो युद्धे तत्परं न तु देवनम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said That best of Rishis, the son of Asita, Devala, who always instructs us about all those acts that may lead(men) to heaven, hell or to the other regions, has said this it is sinful to play deceitfully with a gamester. The best sport is to obtain victory in a righteous battle. Gambling is not a sport.

sa: ब्राह्मणैः सहिता वीरा ह्यवसन् पुरुषर्षभाः। कृष्णायास्तत्र पश्यन्तः क्रीडितान्यमरप्रभाः। विचित्राणि नरव्याघ्रा रेमिरे तत्र पाण्डवाः॥
en: Those foremost of men, those heroes then lived there with the Brahmanas. Those best of men, the celestials-like Pandavas, seeing the various scenes with Krishna (Draupadi) derived great pleasure.

sa: अश्विभ्यां सहितान् देवान् याजयित्वा च तं नृपम्। विख्याप्य वीर्यं लोकेषु सर्वेषु वदतां वरः॥
en: He then assisted that king (Sharyati) to perform sacrifices to all the celestials together with the Ashvins. That foremost of speakers thus spread his fame all over the world.

sa: अग्निरुवाच कथं मां त्वं विजानीये कामार्तमितराः कथम्। यास्त्वता कीर्तिताः सर्वाः सप्तर्षीणां प्रियाः स्त्रियः।
en: Agni said : How did you know that I was afflicted with desire? How did the others, the beloved wives of the seven Rishis, as you say, know this?

sa: पद्भिरेव गमिष्यामो मा राजन् विमना भव। अहं वहिष्ये पाञ्चालीं यत्र यत्र न शक्ष्यति॥
en: We shall walk on foot. O King, you need not trouble yourself about it. I shall carry the Panchala Princess, wherever and whenever she will be incapable of walking.

sa: व्यापृतस्तु श्मशाने यो नित्यं रुद्रस्य वै सखा। पिङ्गलो नाम यक्षेन्द्रो लोकस्यानन्ददायकः॥ एभिश्च सहितो देवस्तत्र याति यथासुखम्। अचतः पृष्ठतश्चैव न हि तस्य गतिर्बुवा॥
en: That foremost of Yakshas, named Pingala, the friend of Rudra, who is always present in the place where corpses are burnt and who is agreeable to all people, merrily marched with him, sometime going in front of the army and sometime falling behind it, his movements were not certain.

sa: सनत्कुमारंधर्मज्ञं संशयच्छेदनाय वै। स च तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा यथातत्त्वं महातपाः। प्रत्युवाचाथ तानेवंधर्मार्थसहितं वचः॥
en: The righteous Sanatkumara in order to solve their doubt. And he (Sanatkumara) of great devotional spirit, hearing their their words, addressed them with these words of true religious import..

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच कथं धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठ जीवो भवति शाश्वतः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं ज्ञातुं तत्त्वेन वदतां वर॥
en: The Brahmana said: O excellent one, learned in the mystery of Karma, O foremost of speakers, how does the spirit become eternal? I desire to hear this in detail.

sa: पुलस्त्य उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि यदृषीणां परायणम्। तदेकाग्रमनाः पुत्र शृणु तीर्थेषु यत् फलम्॥
en: Pulastya said: O son, listen to me with an attentive mind. I shall tell you the virtues which are derived in Tirthas that are the refuge of the Rishis.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्तस्मै कृत्वासौ सह कन्यया। तत्राभ्यगच्छद् देवेन्द्रो यत्र देवर्षयोऽभवन्॥ वसिष्ठप्रमुखा मुख्या विप्रेन्द्राः सुमहाबलाः।
en: Having heard this, Indra, with that damsel bowed to him; and then he went to the place where those great Brahmanas, the mighty celestials Rishis, Mahatmans and other lived.

sa: अगस्त्य उवाच तुष्टोऽहमस्मि कल्याणि तव वृत्तन शोभने। विचारणामपत्ये तु तव वक्ष्यामि तां शृणु।॥
en: Agastya said : O blessed one, O beautiful lady, I am pleased with your conduct. Listen to me as regards the proposal I make in respect of your son.

sa: न बिभेति यदा चायं यदा चास्मान्न बिभ्यति। कामद्वेषौ च जयति तदाऽऽत्मानं च पश्यति॥
en: When one does not fear any creature, nor any creature is frightened at one, when one contracts onc's desire and hatred, then is one said to see one's soul.

sa: राजानं प्रथम विन्देत् ततो भार्यां ततो धनम्। राजन्यसति लोकस्य कुतो भार्या कुतो धनम्॥
en: One should first select a king. Then should he select a wife, and then acquire wealth. If there be no king, what would become of his wife and properties?

sa: भीष्म उवाच इतीदं वसुहोमस्य शृणुयाद् यो मतं नरः। श्रुत्वा सम्यक् प्रवर्तेत सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्॥
en: The person who listens to this teaching of Vasuhoma, and having listened to it behaves according to its trend, is sure to acquire the fruition of all his desires.

sa: यथैव क्षेत्रनिर्याता निर्यातं क्षेत्रमेव च। हिनस्ति धान्यं कक्षं च न च धान्यं विनश्यति॥
en: For reclaiming a field, the reclaimer takes up both paddy blades and weeds. His course, however, instead, of destroying the blades of paddy, he makes them grow more vigorously.

sa: तुल्यं चोभे प्रवर्तेते मरणं जन्म चैव ह। कार्यते चैव कालेन तन्निमित्तं न जीवति॥
en: Birth and Death take place in the same way. Creatures act under the influence of Time, and it is in consequence also of Time that they cease to live.

sa: सर्वत्र रमते प्राज्ञः सर्वत्र च विराजते। न विभीपयते कश्चिद् भीषितो न बिभेति च॥
en: A wise man may be delighted everywhere. Such a mari shines everywhere. He never strikes anybody with fear. If tried to be frightened, he never yields to fear himself.

sa: हतो भीष्मो हतो द्रोणः कर्णो वैकर्तनो हतः॥ मद्रराजो हत: शल्यो हतः कृष्ण जयद्रथः।
en: Bhishma has been killed, Drona has been killed, Karna has been killed, Shalya, the king of the Madras, has been killed and Jayadratha also, O Krishna, has been killed.

sa: निर्वत दुर्योधन यान्तु सैनिका व्रजस्व राजशिबिराय मानदा दिवाकरोऽप्येष विलम्बते प्रभो पुनस्त्वमेवात्र नरेन्द्र कारणम्॥
en: "Retreat Duryodhana. Let your troops retire. O king, run on to your camp. The sun is going down. Remember O king, that you are the root of all this.”

sa: उक्तं भीष्मेण यद वाक्यं हितं तथ्यं च माधव। तचापि नासौ कृतवान् वीतबुद्धिः सुयोधनः॥
en: The words, that were given vent to by Bhishma, O Madhava, were beneficial and should have been accepted. Suyodhana however, who had lost his understanding, did not follow them.

sa: एष ते परमो धर्मः सृष्टो धात्रा महात्मना। तं कुरुष्व यथातथ्यं राजा भव महारथ॥
en: Even this is your highest duty, as laid down by the illustrious Creator himself. Act according to the injunctions of the scriptures and be a king, O great car-warrior.

sa: पृथिव्युवाच सन्ति ब्रह्मन् मया गुप्ताः स्त्रीषु क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥ हैहयानां कुले जातास्ते संरक्षन्तु मां मुने।
en: The Earth said-There are, O Rishi, some leading Kshatriyas concealed by me among women. They were born in the family of the Haihayas. Let them, O sage, protect me.

sa: कथं नु तस्य संग्रामे पृथिवी चक्रमग्रसत्॥ कथं नु शप्तो भ्राता मे तत्त्वं वक्तुमिहार्हसि।
en: Why, indeed, did the Earth swallow up the wheels of his car at the time of battle? Why was my brother cursed? You should relate all this to me.

sa: रुक्मं चापि महामेरुः स्वयं कनकपर्वतः। यक्षराक्षसभर्ता च भगवान् नरवाहनः॥ धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च समर्थं प्रददौ धनम्। हया रथाश्च नागाश्च कोटिशः पुरुषास्तथा॥
en: The great Meru, that mountain of gold, gave him heaps of that precious metal. The divine Kubera carried on shoulders by men, that lord of Yakshas and Rakshasas, gave him wealth enough for perforining the necessary works of religion, profit, and pleasure. Horses, cars, elephants, and men, by millions.

sa: विधास्ये प्राप्तकालं यत् कार्य सिद्धिकरं विभो। मयि कृच्छ्राद् विनिर्मुक्ते न विनक्ष्यति ते कृतम्।।७०।
en: I will do that which is opportune and necessary for the success of our business, O powerful one! If you save me, your service will not go for nothing.

sa: यथा च निहतः पापैः पिता मम विशेषतः॥ प्रत्यक्षमपि ते सर्वं तन्मे मर्माणि कृन्तति।
en: The way in which my father particularly killed by those sinful wretches has been seen by you all. The thought of that destruction is cutting me to the quick.

sa: भीष्म उवाच योगक्षेमो हि राष्ट्रस्य राजन्यायत्त उच्यते। योगक्षेमो हि राज्ञो हि समायत्त पुरोहिते॥
en: Bhishma said It is said that the preservation and advancement of the kingdom depends upon the king. The preservation and advancement of the kings depends upon the king's priest.

sa: द्रोणस्तथोक्तः कर्णेन सापेक्षः फाल्गुनं प्रति। दौरात्म्यं चैव कर्णस्य विदित्वा तमुवाच ह॥ ब्रह्मास्त्रं ब्राह्मणो विद्याद् यथावच्चरितव्रतः। क्षत्रियो वा तपस्वी यो नान्यो विद्यात् कथंचन।॥
en: Thus accosted by him, Drona, on account of partial love for Phalguna, as also from his knowledge of the wickedness of Karna, told him,-None save a Brahmana, who has duly practised all vows, should master the Brahma weapon, or a Kshatriya who has practised austere penances, and no other.

sa: गत्वा च मम विश्वासं दत्त्वा च मम जीवितम्। मित्रोपभोगसमये किं मां त्वं नोपसर्पसि॥
en: Having created confidence in me and having given me my life, why do you not come to me at a time when friends should enjoy the sweets of friendship?

sa: सहदेव उवाच न बाह्यं द्रव्यमुत्सृज्य सिद्धिर्भवति भारत। शारीरं द्रव्यमुत्सृज्य सिद्धिर्भवति वा न वा॥
en: Sahadeva said By renouncing all external objects only, O Bharata, one does not obtain success. Even in the casting off of mental attachments, the attainment of, success is doubtful.

sa: यस्तयोः पूर्वजो जातः स कुशैर्मन्त्रसत्कृतैः। निर्मार्जनीयस्तु तदा कुश इत्यस्य नाम तत्॥ यश्चावरो भवेत्ताभ्यां लवेन सुसमाहितः। निर्मार्जनीयो वृद्धाभिलवेति च स नामतः॥ एवं कुशलवौ नाम्ना तावुभौ यमजातको। मत्कृताभ्यां च नामभ्यां ख्यातियुक्तौ भविष्यतः॥
en: And giving Kuśa sanctified by Mantras to the hands of elderly women he said, “do you rub the person of the elder boy with these”; and giving them Lava he said “do you rub the person of the younger brother with this. And according to this I shall name the first Son Kuśa and the second Lava; and by those names they shall be celebrated on earth.”

sa: वासुकिरुवाच जानासि भद्रे यत्कार्यं प्रदाने कारणं च यत्। पन्नगानां हितार्थाय पुत्रस्ते स्यात्ततो यदि॥
en: Vasuki said: O amiable sister, you know the object for which you were bestowed (on the Rishi,) If a son be born for the good of the snake race.

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्तं दुःखार्तं किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे। कृतवानपि हि त्यागं नैव शान्तिमितो लभे॥
en: I am speaking to you in sorrow; why do you not reply to me? It is true I left you, but I did not get peace where I was.

sa: तं यान्तमनुगच्छन्ति ह्यन्तःपुरचराः स्त्रियः। सवृद्धबालदासीकाः सवर्षवरकिंकराः॥ सान्तःपुरश्च भरतः शत्रुघ्नसहितो ययौ। रामं गतिमुपागम्य साग्निहोत्रमनुव्रताः॥
en: All the female servants, old and young, the damsels of the seraglio accompanied by servants having no manhood, Bharata and Lakşmaņa accompanied by their wives, followed him with Agnihotra.

sa: अक्षौहिण्याः प्रसंख्याता रथानां द्विजसत्तमाः। संख्यागणितत्त्वज्ञैःसहस्राण्येकविंशतिः॥ शतान्युपरिचैवाष्टौ तथा भूयश्च सप्ततिः। गजानां च परीमाणमेतदेव विनिर्दिशेत्॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, mathematicians have calculated that there are twenty one thousand eight hundred and seventy chariots in an Akshauhini. The number of elephants is also the same.

sa: इदमऱ्या प्रतीच्छ त्वं विस्रब्धा विगतज्वरा। यथा स्वगृहमभ्येत्य विषादं चैव मा कृथाः॥ श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं सीता मुनेः परममद्भुतम्। शिरसा वन्द्य चरणौ तथेत्याह कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Do you accept this Arghya now, and confiding in me do you remove your grief. Be not sorry for anything; consider that you have come to your own home. Hearing the wonderful words of the great ascetic, Sītā humbly touched his feet and said Your desire shall be fulfilled.

sa: युक्तरूपो हि सम्बन्धे त्वं नो राजन् वयं तव। एतत् संचिन्त्य मद्रेश गृहाणास्मान् यथाविधि॥
en: O king, you are in every way worthy of alliance with us. We also are worthy of you. O king of Madra, considering all this, accept us in from."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच बभूव ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन्माण्डव्य इति विश्रुतः। धृतिमान् सर्वधर्मज्ञः सत्ये तपसि च स्थितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : There was a certain Brahmana, who was known as Mandavya. He was learned in all the precepts of virtue; he was devoted to truth and asceticism.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं स राजा कुरुनन्दनः। पर्यतप्यत तत्पापं कृत्वा राजा महातपाः॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard these terrible words and recollecting his own sinful act, the king, the descendant of the Kuru race, a great ascetic himself, grew exceedingly sorry.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच नाहं गृहणामि वस्ताता दृष्टी स्मि रुषान्विता। अयं तु भार्गवो नूनमूरुज: कुपितोऽद्य वः॥
en: The Brahmani said : O children, I have not taken your eyesight, nor am I angry with you. This child of the Bhrigu race is certainly angry with you.

sa: दुर्योधनो मन्युमयो महाद्रुमः स्कन्धः कर्णः शकुनिस्तस्य शाखा। दुःशासनः फलपुष्पे समृद्ध मूलं राजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽमनीषी॥
en: Duryodhana is like a great tree created out of anger, Karna is its trunk; Shakuni is its branches; Dushasana its fruit and flowers and weak Dhritarashtra is its root.

sa: जरितोवाच अहं वेगेन तं यान्तमद्राक्षं पततां वरम्। बिलादालुं समादाय श्येनं पुत्रा महाबलम्॥ तं पतन्तं महावेगात् त्वरिता पृष्ठतोऽन्वगाम्। आशिषोऽस्य प्रयुञ्जाना हरतो मूषिकं बिलात्॥
en: Jarita said : O children, I myself saw the great hawk, that best of birds, swoop down with great speed and fly away with the mouse from the hole. I quickly followed the bird and I pronounced blessings upon him for his carrying away the mouse from the hole,

sa: आस्तीकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा यः सर्पो न निवर्तते। शतधा भिद्यते मूर्ध्नि शिंशवृक्ष फलं यथा॥
en: Having heard the words of Astika mentioned, the snake, that will not cease to bite, will have his hood divided into one hundred-fold like the fruit of Shishama tree."

sa: गरुड उवाच किं रूपो ब्राह्मणो मतः किं शीलः किं पराक्रमः। किंस्विदग्निनिभो भाति किंस्वित्सौम्यप्रदर्शनः॥
en: Garuda said: O mother, what form a Brahmana has? What is his character and what is his power? Does he shine like fire or is he of gentle nature?

sa: पृष्टो हि साक्षी यः साक्ष्यं जानानोऽप्यन्यथा वदेत्। स पूर्वानात्मनः सप्त कुले हन्यात्तथा परान्॥
en: A witness, who being asked about a thing which he knows, says something else than what it (really) is, ruins his ancestors and descendants, both to the seventh generations.

sa: ययातिरुवाच द्वाभ्यां कन्यासहस्राभ्यां द्वे कन्ये परिवारिते। गोत्रे च नामनी चैव द्वयोः पृच्छाम्यहं शुभे॥
en: Yayati said : O amiable ladies, it seems that these one thousands maids wait on you two. I would ask you (to tell me) both your names and parentage.

sa: यदाश्रौषं घोषयात्रागतानां बन्धं गंधर्वैर्मोक्षणं चार्जुनेन। स्वेषां सुतानां कर्णबुद्धौ रतानां तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that my sons were taken prisoners by the Gandharvas their journey to Ghoshayatra, but were rescued by Arjuna.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच एवमुक्तो हि पाञ्चाल्यो भारद्वाजेन धीमता। उवाचास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठो द्रोणं ब्राह्मणसत्तमम्॥ एवं भवतु भद्रं ते भारद्वाज महामते। सख्यं तदेव भवतु शश्वद् यदभिमन्यसे॥
en: The Brahmana said: Being thus addressed by the intelligent son of Bharadvaja, the Panchala king spoke thus to that excellent Brahmana, that best of all wielders of arms Drona, "O high-souled son of Bharadvaja, be blessed. Let it be. Let there be everlasting friendship between us as you desire."

sa: तं वृक्षमादाय रिपुप्रमाथी दण्डीव दण्डं पितृराज उग्रम्। तस्थौ समीपे पुरुषर्षभस्य पार्थस्य पार्थः पृथुदीर्घबाहुः॥
en: Taking that tree, the mighty-armed Bhima, the son of Pritha, the chastiser of all foes, stood, like Yama with his fearful staff, near that best of man Partha (Arjuna.)

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पार्थः प्राप्य धनुः श्रेष्ठमक्षय्ये च महेषुधी। रथं ध्वजं सभां चैव युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Partha (Arjuna who had the excellent bow(Gandiva), the couple of inexhaustible quivers and the car with the (Ape) standard and also that Sabha, spoke thus to Yudhishthira.

sa: जगत्प्रभो तप्तसुवर्णवर्चसा त्वं पाहि सर्वांश्च सुरान्महात्मनः। भयान्विता नभसि विमानगामिनो विमानिता विपथगतिं प्रयान्ति ते॥
en: O Lord of the whole universe, by your brilliance like the heated gold, protect the noble celestials, who having been frightened, are flying along the heaven in all directions.

sa: व्यास उवाच मयेदं व्यसनं पूर्वं विदितं भरतर्षभाः। यथा तु तैरधर्मेण धात्रारष्टैर्विवासिताः॥ तद् विदित्वास्मि सम्प्राप्तश्चिकीर्षुः परमं हितम्। न विषादोऽन्न कर्तव्यः सर्वमेतत् सुखाय वः॥
en: Vyasa said : O best of the Bharata race, I knew beforehand of your this affection, your this unjust banishment by the sons of Dhritarashtra. Knowing this I have come to do you some great good. You ought not to grieve. Know all this is for your (future) happiness.

sa: मिथः कृत्यं च तस्मै च आदाय वसु गच्छतु। वृद्धिं च परमां ब्रूयात् त्वत्संयोगोद्भवां तथा॥ सम्प्रीयमाणं त्वां ब्रूयाद् राजन् दुर्योधनं तथा। असकृद् द्रुपदे चैव धृष्टद्युम्ने च भारत॥
en: Let him take costly presents with him for both the bridegroom and the bride and let him speak to him (Draupada) the increase of your power and dignity that has been secured by this alliance. O king, let him say to Draupada and Dhrishtadyumna that both you and Duryodhana have become exceedingly glad by all that has happened.

sa: तपती नाम का चैषा तापत्या यत्कृते वयम्। कौन्तेया हि वयं साधो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: O blessed being! we are the sons of Kunti, therefore, we are Kaunteyas, but who is Tapati that we should be called Tapatyas. I desire to hear about it.

sa: पितर ऊचुः य एष मन्युजस्तेऽग्निर्लोकानादातुमिच्छति। अप्सु तं मुञ्च भद्रं ते लोका ह्यप्सु प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: The Pitris said : Throw this fire of your wrath which desires to consume the worlds into the waters. That will do you good. The worlds rest on water.

sa: अहो वो धिग् बलं क्षात्रं धिगेतां वः कृतास्त्रताम्। भरतस्यान्वये जाता ये वीटां नाधिगच्छत॥
en: "Shame on your Kshatriya prowess and shame also on your skill in arms! Being born in the race of Bharata, how is it that you cannot recover the ball!

sa: तत्र स्थितं मां देवसुखेषु सक्तं कालेऽतीते महति ततोऽतिमात्रम्। दूतो देवानामब्रवीदुग्ररूपो ध्वंसेत्युचैस्त्रिः प्लुतेन स्वरेण॥
en: I lived there in celestial happiness for many years, when a celestial messenger of grim visage thrice shouted to me in a loud and deep voice, “Ruined, Ruined, Ruined."

sa: भीष्म उवाच न रोचते विग्रहो मे पाण्डुपुत्रैः कथंचन। यथैव धृतराष्ट्रो मे तथा पाण्डुरसंशयम्॥
en: Bhishma said: O Dhritarashtra, I can never consent to a quarrel with the sons of Pandu. There is no doubt Pandu was to me as you are to me.

sa: आसाद्य शान्तनुस्तां च बुभुजे कामतो वशी। न प्रष्टव्येति मन्वानो न स तां किंचिदूचिवान्॥
en: King Shantanu also was exceedingly pleased to get her for his wife. He fully enjoyed her sweet company. Adhering to his promise, he refrained refrained from asking her anything.

sa: दुपद उवाच एकस्य बढ्यो विहिता महिष्य कुरुनन्दन। नैकस्या बहवः पुंसः श्रूयन्ते पतयः क्वचित्॥
en: Drupada said : O descendant of Kuru, it is ordained that a husband can have many wives, but we have never heard that a wife can have many husbands.

sa: इदं राज्यं च सकलं जीवितं च हृदि स्थितम्। सर्वमेतद् द्विजार्थं मे सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वः॥
en: And this entire monarchy, and the life that is resident in my heart, all these are for the regenerate ones. This I tell you in the name of truth.

sa: तस्य राज्ञः पुरे तस्मिन् समा द्वादश सत्तम। न ववर्ष सहस्राक्षो राष्ट्रे चैवास्य भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, for those twelve years the god of one thousand eyes (Indra) did nor pour any rains on the capital and the kingdom of that king.

sa: एते भीमस्य संत्रस्ता: सिंहस्येवेतरे मृगाः। शरैः संत्रासिताः संख्ये न लभन्ते सुखं क्वचित्।। ८८
en: As the stags feel anxiety with fear of lion, these Kauravas' soldiers are so frightened of the arrows shot by Bhimasena as they are anxious everywhere in the battle-field.

sa: संजय उवाच नकुलं रभसं युद्धे द्रावयन्तं वरूथिनीम्। कर्णो वैकर्तनो राजन् वारयामास वै रुषा॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, Karna the son of Vikartana, indeed, restrained with great rage Nakula, who was destroying and dispersing the army (belonging to the Kurus) in that battle.

sa: ब्रह्मास्त्रेण त्वथा दग्धा अनस्त्रज्ञा नरा भुवि। यदेतदीदृशां विप्र कृतं कर्म न साधु तत्॥
en: You have today consumed with your Brahma weapon many men who are ignorant of the use of weapons. This act which you have done is not at all praise-worthy.

sa: संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य वहतो महतीं धुरम्॥ धरण्यां मम पुत्रस्य पातयिष्यति यः शिरः। तस्यापि शतधा मूर्धा फलिष्यति न संशयः॥ एवमुक्त्वा ततो राज्ये स्थापयित्वा जयद्रथम्।
en: That man who will caused the head of my sons to fall on the earth, struggling in battle, will be bearing a great burden. I say that the head of that man will crack into a hundred pieces.' Having spoken these words and having installed Jayadratha on the throne.

sa: कर्णो द्वात्रिंशत चैव वृषसेनश्च सप्तभिः। जयद्रथस्त्रिसप्तत्या कृपश्च दशभिः शरैः॥ मद्रराजश्च दशभिर्विव्यधुः फाल्गुनं रणे।
en: Karna with thirty-two, Vrishasena, with seven, Jayadratha with seventy-three and Kripa with ten shafts and the king of the Madras with ten other shafts, pierced Phalguna in that battle.

sa: अद्यसौ सौबलः कृष्ण ग्लहाजानातु वै शरान्। दुरोदरं च गाण्डीवं मण्डलं च रथं प्रति॥
en: Let the son of Subal realize today, O Krishna, that my arrows happen to be my dice, my Gandiva is my gaming board and my chariot, my chequered cloth.

sa: एतद् व्रतं महाबाहो त्वया सह कृतं मया। तथैतन्मम कौन्तेय यथा तव न संशयः॥
en: I have made this vow jointly with you, O mighty armed one. O son of Kunti undoubtedly, as they (these vows) are to you so they are to me.

sa: तस्य विद्धस्य बाणेन कराच्चापं पपात ह। पुनरादाय तचापं निमेषार्धान्महाबलः॥ छादयामास बाणौघैः फाल्गुनं कृतहस्तवत्।
en: Taking up that bow within half the time of the twinking of an eye, that highly powerful one, with great nibleness of hand, covered Phalguna with downpours of arrows.

sa: एतत् कृत्वा महत् कर्म हत्वा कर्ण महारथम्। कृतार्थः सफलः पार्थ सुखी भव नरोत्तम॥
en: And accomplishing this proud feat, O Partha and achieving victory over the master car-warrior, Karna, may you, the best of men, gain your ends and be successful and happy.

sa: बभूवुर्विमला: सर्वा दिशो राजन् समन्ततः। चाषाक्ष शतपत्राश्च क्रौञ्चाश्चैव जनेश्वर॥ प्रदक्षिणमकुर्वन्त तदा वै पाण्डुनन्दनम्।
en: O king, the whole universe turned calm for the time being. O lord of men blue jays (the king-fishers), wood-packers, herons, began to hover round the son of Pandu.

sa: शोकमायुः परे चैव कुरुः सर्व एव ते। अमन्यन्त च पुत्रं ते वैश्वानरमुखे हुतम्॥
en: Then many among the enemies and the Kurus were filled with grief, as they then considered your son to be like a libation poured into the mouth of fire.

sa: मृद्गतः सर्वसैन्यानि युगान्तमिव कुर्वतः। न हि देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरा न च राक्षसाः॥
en: As I grind all creatures like the Destroyer himself at the hour of Dissolution. Neither the gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Asuras, nor the reptiles, nor the Rakshasas.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽब्रवीत् पार्थ केशवो राजसत्तम॥ शक्तोऽसि भरतश्रेष्ठ हन्तुं कर्णं महाबलम्। एष चापि हि मे कामो नित्यमेव महारथ॥ कथं भवान् रणे कर्णं निहन्यादिति सत्तम।
en: O foremost of kings, upon Partha's uttering these words Keshava said unto him-"O mighty Bharata, you are well worthy of slaying Karna. Indeed, O best of men, O foremost of car-warriors, it has ever been upper most in my thoughts as to how you would succeed in slaying him.”

sa: रथनीकं विदार्यैव शरजालैरनेकधा। कर्ण एकरथेनैव युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्॥ सेनानिवेशमार्छन्त मार्गणैः क्षतविक्षतम्। यमयोर्मध्यगं वीरं शनैर्यान्तं विचेतसम्॥
en: Dispersing that car-force with his arrows Karna, in a chariot, pursued the heroic Yudhishthira, who, then wounded with arrows and almost unconscious, slowly proceeding towards encampment between the twins.

sa: शङ्कमानः स तन्मिथ्या वीर्यज्ञः स्वसुतस्य वै। हतः स इति च श्रुत्वा नैव धैर्यादकम्पत॥
en: But knowing fully the prowess of his own son, he soon came to regard that news as false and therefore hearing of his slaughter he did not become unmanned.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच गच्छ त्वं मदनुज्ञातो निहनिष्यसि शात्रवान्॥ विजित्य च रिपून् सर्वान्गुणान् प्राप्यसि पुष्कलान्।
en: Maheshvara said Being commanded by me, do you start at once. You will slaughter these enemies. Having thus subdued all these enemies, you will surely gain innumerable excellent virtues.

sa: स तेनास्रेण शैलेन्द्रः क्षिप्तः क्षिप्रं व्यनश्यत॥ ततः स तोयदो भूत्वा नीलः सेन्द्रायुधो दिवि।
en: By means of that weapon he soon destroyed that prince of mountains. Then he (i.e., Ghatotkacha) wearing the shape of a blue cloud adorned with rain-bow in the firmament.

sa: अजयत् सर्वसैन्यानि शार्दूल इव गोवृषान्॥ भोजानीकमतिक्रम्य दरदानां च वाहिनीम्।
en: Bhima defeated them all like a tiger defeating a herd of bulls. Then passing through the Bhoja and Kamboja divisions.

sa: तं मृधे वेगमास्थाय नृपाः परमधन्विनः। चोदितास्तव पुत्रैश्च सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Urged on by your sons, many king all foremost bowmen, rushing with forces began to surround Bhima from all sides.

sa: दुर्योधनं तथा दृष्ट्वा शीघ्रमस्त्रमुदैरयत्॥ तेन यौधिष्ठिरं सैन्यमवधीत् पार्षतं तथा।
en: Beholding Duryodhana in that condition and quickly getting ready his weapon he soon struck the sons of Yudhishthira and Prishata.

sa: अथोत्क्रुष्टं महाराज पञ्चालैर्जितकाशिभिः। मोक्षितं पार्षतं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणपुत्रं च पीडितम्॥
en: Seeing Prishata's son released and Drona's son wounded, the Panchalas, O king, jubilant over the victory, sent up loud war-cries.

sa: हताहरत गृह्णीत विध्यत व्यवकृन्तत। इत्यासीत् तुमुलः शब्दो युधिष्ठिररथं प्रति॥
en: Then a tumultuous uproar (such as) “Slay, seize, capture, pierce and cut to pieces”-arose in the direction of Yudhishthira's car.

sa: दुर्मर्षणो दुर्विषहो दुर्जयश्च महारथः। कृत्वा त्वसुकरं कर्म गता वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Having achieved the extraordinary exploits in battle. Durmarsana, Durvisaha and the great car-warrior Durjaya departed to the region of Death.

sa: अपीदानीं भवेदस्य क्षेममस्मिन् समागमे। कचिन्नं सागरं तीर्वा सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Will Satyaki reap victory in this encounter? Having crossed the ocean itself will Satyaki of prowess incapable of being vanquished.

sa: हृदयान्याशु वीराणां विविशुः प्रियबन्धुवत्। य एनमीयुः समरे त्वद्योधाः शूरमानिनः॥
en: Entered into the hearts of heroes, as if they were their intimate friends. Those of then ventured to encounter Arjuna.

sa: कुञ्जराश्च हता राजन् दुद्रुवुस्ते समन्ततः। अश्वाश्च पर्यधावन्त हतारोहा दिशो दश॥ स्था हीना महाराज रथिर्भिर्वाजिभिस्तथा। गन्धर्वनगराकारा दृश्यन्ते स्म सहस्रशः॥
en: O king, elephants and rider-less horses being hurt began to fly hither and thither and numberless cars without horses and riders could be seen there changing their forms like smoke when rising into the sky resembling the city of Gandharvas.

sa: अथाशु निशितं भल्लं शैनेयः कृतवर्मणः। प्रेषयामास समरे शरांश्च चतुरोऽपरान्॥
en: arrows Thereafter the grandson of Sini quickly sped at Kritavarman a whetted bhalla and four other shafts in that battle.

sa: देवदत्तं च कौन्तेयः पाञ्चजन्यं च केशवः। शब्दस्तु देवदत्तस्य धनंजयसमीरितः॥
en: Kunti's son blew his conch Devadatta and Keshava blew Panchajanya. The tremendous blare of the conch Devedatta, produced by Dhananjaya.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सुषेणः क्रोधमूर्छितः। आविध्यन्नकुलं षष्ट्या सहदेवं च सप्तभिः।
en: Then beside himself with anger Sushena took up another bow and pierced Nakula with sixty arrows and Sahadeva with seven.

sa: तद् युद्धं सुमहद् घोरमासीद् देवासुरोपमम्॥ निघ्नतां सायकैस्तूर्णमन्योन्यस्य वधं प्रति।
en: Then there took place a dreadful encounter between those heroes striking one another like that between the gods and demons.

sa: कार्येणात्यर्थगूढेन वाहीकेषूषितं मया। तत एषां समाचारः संवासाद् विदितो मम॥
en: For some secret work I had to live with them. On account of this living I know them very well.

sa: आगच्छमानास्तान् संख्ये प्रहृष्टान् विजयैषिणः। दधारैको रणे कर्णो जलौघानिव पर्वतः॥
en: As a mountain holds water so Karna alone received in battle those warriors filed with joy and longing for victory.

sa: तेनच्छन्न नभो राजन् बाणजालेन भास्वता। अभ्रच्छायेव संजज्ञे बाणरुद्ध नभस्तले॥
en: O king, the sky being covered with a network of shining arrows a shadow appeared there like that of clouds.

sa: शैनेयशकसहंछन्नं तव सैन्यं विशाम्पते। भेजे दश दिशस्तूर्णं न्यपतच गतासुवत्॥
en: Covered with arrows shot by Sini's grandson your soldiers, O king, fled away in all directions and dropped down dead.

sa: कर्णस्ततो महाराज पाण्डवं नवभिः शरैः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः क्रुद्धरूपं परंतप॥
en: Then, O afflicter of foes, the enraged Karna, O monarch, struck the irate Bhima on the breast with nine shafts.

sa: मत्स्याः शाल्वाः ससेनाश्च द्रोणमेव ययुयुधि। दुपदश्च तथा राजा पञ्चालैरभिरक्षितः॥
en: And the Matsyas and the Shalvas with their own divisions advanced against Drona for battle. protected by the Panchalas, Drupada.

sa: योऽसौ कृष्णामब्रवीद् दुष्टबुद्धिः कर्णः सभायां कुरुवीरमध्ये। किं पाण्डवांस्त्वं न जहासि कृष्णे सुदुर्बलान् पतितान् हीनसत्त्वान्॥ योऽसौ कर्णः प्रत्यजानात्त्वदर्थे नाहं हत्वा सह कृष्णेन पार्थम्। इहोपयातेति स पापबुद्धिः कचिच्छेते शरसम्भिन्नगात्रः॥
en: That designing Karna who amidst the assembly of the Kuru chiefs had said to Krishna 'why don't you, O Krishna, desert the powerless, imbecile and degraded Pandavas'-that Karna who had vowed solemnly that he would not return from the field till he slew (both) Krishna and Partha-tell me does that vicious Karna lie today on the field with mangled limbs?

sa: सहिताः सन्यवर्तन्त द्रोणमेव द्विजर्षभम्। तेषु शुरेषु युद्धाय गतेषु भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of men, jointly proceeded against Drona. O best of the Bharatas, those warriors having proceeded for the fight.

sa: अथ हंसोऽप्यतिक्रम्य मुहूर्तमिति चेति च॥ अवेक्षमाणस्तं काकं नाशकद् व्यपसर्पितुम।
en: Doing a great distance in a moment the swan looked back at the crow and could not leave him behind.

sa: दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं कृष्णो व्यतिक्रान्तं सहानुगम्। अब्रवीदर्जुनं राजन् प्राप्तकालमिदं वचः॥
en: Then seeing Duryodhana and his followers outrun Dhananjaya, Krishna, O king addressing Arjuna, said these words suited to the occasion.

sa: सात्यकिः समे विद्धः कैकेयेन महात्मना। कैकेयं पञ्चविंशत्या विव्याध प्रहसत्रिव॥
en: In the battle, Satyaki, having been pierced by the lofty-minded Kaikeya, smilingly pierced back the Kaikeya chief with twenty-five shafts.

sa: तामस्य वाचं देवाश्च ऋषयश्च महात्मनः। सर्वसैन्यानि चाक्षुद्रां प्रहृष्टाः प्रत्यपूजयन्॥
en: Those generous words of the illustrious Arjuna were highly applauded by the Rishis, the celestials and the highly delighted soldiers.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे हर्षयन्तो धनंजयम्। तूर्यशङ्खनिनादेन दिशः सर्वा व्यनादयन्॥
en: The Pandavas also for rousing Dhananjaya caused all the sides to resound with the sound of their drums and conchs.

sa: स तु क्रुद्धस्ततो राजन्नाशीविष इव श्वसन्। सात्यकिं पञ्चविंशत्या प्रत्यविध्यच्छिलीमुखैः॥
en: Thereupon worked up with rage, O king, he, sighing like a deadly serpent, struck Satyaki with twenty five sharpened arrows.

sa: ॥ सुवर्णविकृतान् बाणान् विमुञ्चान्तावरिंदमौ। भाखरं व्योम चक्राते महोल्काभिरिव प्रभौ॥
en: O Lord, those two subduers of foes shooting arrows decked with gold, 'illumined the welkin like meteors illumining the skies.

sa: योद्धव्यमद्य पार्थेन फाल्गुनेन त्वया सह। किमर्थ धर्मराजेन युध्यसे भृशरोषितः॥
en: "You are to fight today with Pandu's son, Phalguna. Why do you, irate, then fight with the pious king Yudhishthira?

sa: कर्णेन त्रास्यमानानामवस्थानं न विद्यते॥ पश्यामि च तथा कर्णे विचरन्तमभीतवत्।
en: And frightened by Karna, they have no stay or support. I see that Karna is careering dauntlessly on the field.

sa: त्वरमाणास्तु तान् सर्वान् ससूतेष्वसनध्वजान्। जघान् नवतिं वीरानुर्जुनो निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then Arjuna, with sharp arrows, cut-off their bows, banners and sent them all with their drivers to the other world.

sa: ते तु सेने समासाद्य वेगवत्यौ परस्परम्॥ एकीभावमनुप्राप्ते नद्याविव समागमे।
en: That the two furious armies, approaching one another, formed one mass like two furious rivers that run into each other.

sa: संजय उवाच आशा बलवती राजन् पुत्रस्य तव याऽभवत्। हते भीष्मे च द्रोणे च कर्णो जेष्यति पाण्डवान्॥ तामाशां हृदये कृत्वा कर्णमेवं तदाब्रवीत्। सूतपुत्र न ते पार्थः स्थित्वाग्रे संयुयुत्सति॥
en: Sanjaya said That after the slaughter of both Bhishma and Drona, Karna would surely subdue the Pandavas, this hope, O king, of your son was found to be very great. Having entertained in the mind that strong hope, he then addressed Karna saying thus-"O son of Suta, the son of Pritha would never fight, staying before you (in the field)."

sa: सोमदत्तश्च भूरिश्च तथा द्रौणिर्विविंशतिः॥ : तिष्ठेयुर्दशिता यत्र सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।
en: And Somadatta, Bhuri, the son of Drona and Vivingsati-all well-skilled in warfare, remain (prepared for battle) with their armours on.

sa: कृतवर्मा तु निर्जित्य धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्। पुनर्दोणस्य जुगुपे चक्रमेव महात्मनः॥
en: Having defeated Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, the mighty car-warrior Kritavarma again engaged himself in protecting the carwheels of Drona.

sa: चित्रकेतुः सुधन्वा च चित्रवर्मा च भारत। तथा चित्ररथश्चैव भ्रातृव्यसनकशिंताः॥
en: Chitraketu, Sudhanvan, Chitravarman and O Bharata, also Chitraratha-all afflicted with son grief at the calamity that had befallen their brother.

sa: प्रतिज्ञा पालयिष्यामि हत्वैनं नरसत्तमम्। एतदर्थं मया खड्गो गृहीतो यदुनन्दन॥
en: I will redeem my vow by slaying this best of men. For this alone I have taken up the sword.

sa: समसज्जन्त राजेन्द्र समरे भृशवेदनाः। ततो विराटद्रुपदौ द्रोणं प्रययतू रणे॥
en: And suffering extreme pain, O king, fought on with Drona. Thereafter Virata and Drupada, both rushed against Drona in battle.

sa: मित्रवर्मा त्रिसप्तत्या सौश्रुतिश्चापि सप्तभिः। शत्रुजयस्तु विशत्या सुशर्मा नवभिः शरैः॥
en: Again, Mitravarman (pierced) him (Arjuna) with seventy-three shafts; Sausruti with seven; and Satrunjaya, with twenty; and Shusharma, with nine arrows.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं महाराजं जिगीषू समवस्थितम्। सहानीकं ततो द्रोणो न्यवारयत वीर्यवान्॥
en: Then the valorous Drona began to resist king Yudhishthira and his troops, when they were exerting themselves for obtaining victory.

sa: महात्मा फाल्गुनश्चापि सत्यधर्मरतः सदा। विजयस्तस्य नयतं जायते नात्र संशयः॥
en: O king of Heaven, as the noble minded Phalgun is truthful and virtuous undoubtedly he must always be the conqueror.

sa: अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च त्वरमाणौ महाद्युती। अवप्लुत्य रथाद् वीरौ भीममाद्रवतां ततः॥
en: Those two brave heroes of great effulgence viz., Arjuna and Vasudeva, then jumping down from their chariot, ran towards Bhima.

sa: बालां बन्धुमती यन्मामधर्मेणोपगच्छथ। तस्मानार्यो भविष्यन्ति बन्धक्यो वै कुलस्य च॥
en: As you have sinfully ravished a girl who has no husband all the women of your families will become unchaste.

sa: वार्यमाणा महासेना पुत्रैस्तव जनेश्वरः। न चातिष्ठत संग्रामे पीड्यमाना समन्ततः॥
en: Although prevented, O king, by your sons that great army assailed on all sides did not stop in the battle-field.

sa: तच्छिन्नमपतद् भूमौ युयुत्सोः सारथेस्तदा। तारारूपं यथा चित्रं निपपात महीतले॥
en: The cut-off head of Yuyutsu fell on ground as if any excellent star is fallen from sky on the ground.

sa: संदृश्य समरे भीमं रक्षसा ग्रस्तमन्तिकात्। वासुदेवोऽब्रवीद् राजन् घटोत्कचमिदं वचः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding Bhima hard pressed in battle by the Rakshasa Vasudeva's approaching Ghatotkacha said these words to him.

sa: ततस्तु चेदिकारूषान् सृञ्जयांश्च महारथान्। कर्णो जघान समरे भीमसेनस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Karna killed in the battle many strong carwarriors of the Chedis, Karushas and Srinjayas in the very presence of Bhimasena.

sa: सर्वांश्च समरे राजन् किरीटी क्षत्रियर्षभान्। परिचिक्षेप बीभत्सुः सर्वतः प्रकिरछरान्॥
en: The diadem-decked Vibhatsu, O monarch, in that battle, discharging arrows on all sides, began to overthrow many foremost of Kshatriyas.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः पुत्रं दुर्योधनं तव॥ अभ्यवर्तत युद्धाय त्रासयन् सर्वधन्विनः।
en: Having thus addressed your Duryodhana, that one, possessed of mighty arms (i.e., Ashvatthama), distressing all bow men, proceeded to battle.

sa: ज्वलितैस्तैः शरै।रैः कङ्कबहिणवाजितैः। संछन्ना पाण्डवी सेना न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन॥
en: Covered fully with those shining and dreadful Kanka and peacock-feathered arrows the Pandava soldiers could see nothing in the battle-field.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं तावकानां समुत्थितम्। प्रदध्मतुः शङ्खवरौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: Hearing that dreadful din raised by your troops, Dhananjaya and the son of Vasudeva blew their two best of conchs.

sa: ते तु द्रौणिविनिर्मुक्ताः शरा हेमविभूषिताः। अजसमन्वकीर्यन्त घोरा भीमरथं प्रति॥
en: Those arrows discharged from the bow of Drona's son and decked with gold and dreadful, feel incessantly upon Bhima's car.

sa: एते चरन्ति संग्रामे कर्णचापच्युताः शराः। भ्रमराणामिव वातास्तापयन्ति स्म तावकान्॥
en: Those arrows flung from the bow-strings of Kamna, afflicting your hosts in battle, are hovering round like swarms of bees.

sa: संजय उवाच तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य भीमकर्माणमाहवे। हर्षमाहारयांचक्रुः कुरवः सर्व एव ते॥
en: Sanjaya said Then beholding Alayudha of fierce deeds come to fight on their behalf, all the Kouravas, were exceedingly delighted.

sa: अस्त्र हि रामात् कर्णेन भार्गवादृषिसत्तमात्। यदुपात्तं महाघोरं तस्य रूपमुदीर्यते॥
en: The weapon which Karna obtained from that foremost sage Rama, the son of Bhrigu, is blazing forth its appalling form.

sa: समेतौ तौ महात्मानौ दृष्ट्वा कणूदनंजयौ। अकम्पन्त त्रयौ लोकाः सहदेववर्षितारणाः॥
en: The gods, the Rishis and all the creations of the three worlds began to shake with fear sceing that fight.

sa: ततो ययौ हृषीकेश यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः। शीघ्रच्छीघ्रतरं राजन् वीजिभिर्गरुडोपमैः॥
en: Thereupon Hrishikesha drove quickly where Yudhishthira was. Quickly was he borne there, O king, by the horses resembling Garuda himself.

sa: यदिच्छसि शिरश्चास्य असिना हन्तुमाहवे। तथा कृच्छ्रगतं चैव सात्यकिं कः क्षमिष्यति॥ त्वं वै विगर्हयात्मानमात्मानं यो न रक्षसि। कथं करिष्यसे वीर यो वा त्वां संश्रयेज्जनः॥
en: I could not possibly behold passively Satyaki reduced to that plight. It is proper that you should reproach your own self in as much as you neglected to protect yourself (when trying to injure another). Indeed O hero, how would you yourself have behaved towards one who would be your dependent.

sa: यथा हरिहयैर्युक्तं संगृह्णाति स मातलिः। शल्यस्तथा तवाद्यायं संयन्ता स्थवाजिनाम्॥
