en: As Matali manages his car drawn by the horse of Hari so will Shalya manage today your car and horses.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। चाण्डालस्य च संवादं क्षाबन्धोश्च भारत॥
en: Bhishma said I shall, about it, O Bharata, recite to you the conversation between a Chandala and a low Kshatriya.

sa: महत्या सेनया सार्धं ततो युद्धमवर्तत। स्थानां च रणे राजन्नन्योन्यमभिधावताम्॥
en: With a vast force. Then there took place a battle again, o king, between car-warriors engaged in striking one another.

sa: संजय उवाच विदार्य कर्णस्तां सेनां युधिष्ठिरमथाद्रवत्। रथहस्त्यश्वपत्तीनां सहस्रः परिवारितः॥
en: Sanjaya said Riving through that army Karna encountered the pious king surrounded by thousands of cars, elephants, horses and footsoldiers.

sa: नहुषेण विसृष्टा च बृहस्पतिमथाब्रवीत्। समयोऽल्पावशेषो मे नहुषेणेह यः कृतः॥
en: Being dismissed by Nahusha, she said to Brihaspati-“But little remains to fulfill in its entirety the boon granted by Nahusha.

sa: ततस्ते योधमुख्याश्च सहसा पर्यवारयन्॥ स तानापततः सर्वान् रुद्रास्त्रेण व्यपोथयत्।
en: Thereat those foremost of warriors suddenly surrounded Drona's son. The latter killed them ail the means of the Rudra weapon.

sa: तत् तु विप्रहतं सैन्यं भीमसेनमुखास्तदा॥ भूयः समाद्रवनं वीराः सात्यकिप्रमुखास्तदा।
en: The Pandava heroes headed by Bhimasena and Satyaki again attacked fiercely on Kaurava's army already destroyed in its considerable fraction.

sa: प्रादुर्भावसहस्रेषु तेषु तेषु त्वया विभो। अधर्मरुचयः कृष्ण निहताः शतशोऽसुराः॥
en: O exalted one, O Krishna, in your incarnations on three thousand occasions, you have killed the sinful Asuras by thousands.

sa: के पन्थान: शिवाश्च स्युः किं सुखं किं च दुष्कृतम्। एतान् मे भगवन् प्रश्चान् याथातथ्येन सुव्रत॥ वक्तुमर्हसि विप्रर्षे यथावदिह तत्त्वतः। त्वदन्यः कश्चन प्रश्चानेतान् वक्तुमिहार्हति॥
en: What paths are to be called auspicious? What is happiness? What is sin? O holy one, O you of excellent vows, you should answer these questions of mine, O learned Rishi, correctly, truly, and accurately. Who else is there in this world than you who is capable of answering these questions?

sa: सर्वासप्रतिघातार्थं विहितं पद्मयोनिना। ततो मुहूर्तादिव तत् तमो व्युपशशाम ह॥
en: That had been created by lotus-born Brahma for baffling all weapons. Then in a moment only that darkness was dispelled.

sa: अत्र साम स्म गायन्ति सामगाः पुण्यनि:स्वनाः। मरीचिः पुलहश्चैव भृगुश्चैवाङ्गिरास्तथा॥
en: And the singers of the Sama (Veda) the Rishis, Marichi, Pulaha, Bhrigu and Angirasa chant the hymns in this place.

sa: स्वागतं तेऽस्त्विति प्राह मुनिः सत्यवतीसुतः। आस्यतामिति होवाच प्रसन्नात्मा महामुनिः॥
en: Satyavati's son, endued with high penances, answered, saying, "Welcome!' Of tranquil soul the great ascetic further said, 'Take our seat.'

sa: चकार कदनं घोरं दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा महाबलः॥ अन्यानन्यांश्च पुरुषानभिसृत्याभिसृत्य च।
en: An expert in the use of the sword, Ashvatthaman then, rushing against other warriors, cut them down with his sword.

sa: साधिक्षेपं वचः श्रुत्वा संक्रुद्धः श्वेतकिर्नृपः। कैलास पर्वतं गत्वा तप उग्रं समास्थितः॥ आराधयन् महादेवं नियतः संशितव्रतः। उपवासपरो राजन् दीर्घकालमतिष्ठत॥
en: Having heard these words of censure and wrath, the king Shvetaki became angry. Going to the Kailasa mountain, he begin to worship the God (Shiva), observing rigid vows and performing austere penances. Giving up all food, he passed many years.

sa: दृष्ट्वा च विश्वकर्माणं व्यादिदेश पितामहः। सृज्यतां प्रार्थनीयैका प्रमदेति महातपाः॥
en: Seeing Vishvakarma, the Grandsire commanded him saying, “O great ascetic, create a damsel who will be captivating to all hearts?"

sa: तत्र पूर्वव्यतीतानि विक्रान्तानीतराणि च। बहूनि कथयित्वा तौ रेमाते पार्थमाधवौ॥
en: Partha and Madhava amused themselves there by talking over their past achievements and discoursing on heroism and various other topics.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां नारदो भगवानृषिः। आश्वासयद् धर्मसुतं युक्तरूपमिवानघ॥
en: O sinless one, having received their worship, the exalted Rishi Narada comforted the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira) in proper words.

sa: ततः प्रकाशे शिविरे खड्डेन पितृनन्दनः॥ अश्वत्थामा महाराज व्यचरत् कृतहस्तवत्।
en: When the camp was lighted, Ashvatthaman, O king, moved about sword in hand, and crushing his foes with great skill.

sa: ततो रथं पुनद्रौणिरास्थितो भीमनि:स्वनम्। धनुष्पाणिः शरैरन्यान् प्रेषयद् वै यमक्षयम्॥
en: Drona's son once more mounted his car, and taking up his bow sent many with his arrows to Yama's abode.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवः क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभम्। उपतस्थुर्महात्मानं विविशुश्चासने शुभे॥
en: These and many other Kshatriyas approached that best of Kshatriyas of illustrious fame; and they sat down on auspicious seats.

sa: ते रात्रौ प्रस्थिताः सर्वे सह मात्रा यशस्विनः। अभ्यगच्छन्महारण्ये हिडिम्बवनमन्तिकात्॥
en: Setting out that night with their illustrious mother, they (the Pandavas) came near the great forest, the forest of Hidimba.

sa: अथ हंसा विससृपुः सर्वतः प्रमदावने। एकैकशस्तदा कन्यास्तान् हंसान् समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Thereupon the swans fled in all directions in that charming forcst; and the ladies ran after them, each pursuing one.

sa: नाधनो धर्मकृत्यानि यथावदनुतिष्ठति। धनाद्धि धर्मः स्त्रवति शैलादभि नदी यथा॥
en: The man who has no wealth cannot celebrate religious acts, for these originate from wealth, like rivers from a mountain.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि तैर्विमुक्तानि भस्मसात्। कृत्वा तदस्त्रं तान् वीराननयद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Then that weapon. consuming the thousands of shafts discharged by the enemy, conveyed those heroes to the regions of Death.

sa: मुण्डतालवनानीव तत्र तत्र चकाशिरे। छिन्ना रथध्वजवाताः केचित्तत्र क्वचित् क्वचित्॥
en: At places several crowds of chariots, having their flag-staffs severed, looked like forests of palmyra trees deprived of their heads.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। संवादं मोक्षसंयुक्तं शिष्यस्य गुरुणा सह॥
en: Vasudeva said Regarding it is recited the old discourse between a preceptor and his disciple on the subject of Brahma.

sa: अद्रिसारमयीं भीमस्तथैवादाय वीर्यवान्॥ आह्वयामास नृपति सिंह सिंहो यथा वने।
en: Likewise the brave Bhima, taking up his adamantine mace, challenged the king like a lion challenging a lion. or or

sa: योज्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन् बाणे धनुषि पूजिते। चचाल पृथिवी राजन् सशैलवनकानना॥
en: When that arrow was set on the bow-string, O king, the earth shook with her mountains, watery expanses and forests.

sa: अभियास्यति मां कोपात् सम्बन्धी सुमहाबलः। हिरण्यवर्मा नृपतिः कर्षमाणो वरूथिनीम्॥
en: “My son's father-in-law, king Hiranyavarman, having mustered a large army, is advancing against me with anger, powerful as he is.

sa: शिष्यैः परिवृतो विद्वान् नीतिशास्त्रार्थकोविदः। पाण्डवानां हितार्थाय कौरवान् प्रति जग्मिवान्॥
en: The priest, who was learned in scriptures of ethics and economy went to the city of Kauravas with his disciples.

sa: अदृश्यन्त्यां च वासिष्ठो वसिष्ठश्चाक्षमालया। च्यवनश्च सुकन्यायां पुलस्त्यः संध्यया यथा॥
en: As the son of Vasishtha with Adrishyanli and Vasishtha with Akshamala; as Chyavana with Sukanya and as Pulastya with Sandhya,

sa: नैवटुं तन्न यजुषु नाप्यथर्वसु न दृश्यते वै विमलेषु सामसु। रथन्तरे बार्हद्रथे वाऽपि राजन् महाव्रते नैव दृश्येद् ध्रुवं तत्॥
en: Nor in the Rich, nor in the Yajush, nor in the Atharva, nor in the sacred Sama (Vedas). It is certain, O king, that it cannot be seen in the Rathantara, nor in the Barhadrath, nor in the great vows.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण हरीन्द्रा हरयस्तथा। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
en: Being thus addressed by Rāma, all the leading monkeys bears as well as the Rākşasa Vibhīşaņa said with folded hands.

sa: तेन बद्धस्ततोऽस्त्रेण राक्षसेन स वानरः। अभवन्निर्विचेष्टश्च पपात च महीतले॥
en: And being bound up by that Rākşasa with the weapon, the monkey became motionless and fell down on the earth.

sa: स सीतामार्गणे व्यग्रः सुग्रीवः सत्यसंगरः। हरीन्सम्प्रेषयामास दिशः सर्वा हरीश्वरः॥
en: And, thereupon, the lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, true to his vow, eager for searching Sītā, despatched monkeys in all directions.

sa: क्रोधवेगेन संयुक्तः सत्त्वेन च बलेन च। अचलाग्रादथोत्थाय पुप्लुवे गोपुरस्थले॥
en: And influenced by wrath, he, mustering strength and vigour, rising from the brow of the mountain, bounded to the gateway.

sa: हता इन्द्रजिता सीता इति श्रुत्वैव राघवः। हनूमद्वचनात्सौम्य ततो मोहमुपाश्रितः॥
en: O placid one, hearing from Hanumān's lips that Sītā has been slain by Indrajit. Rāghava has been overcome with stupor.

sa: पर्वतेन्द्रं सुनाभं च समुपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान्॥ व्यामुक्त इव नाराचो महावेगोऽभ्युपागमत्।
en: And touching Mainaka-foremost of mountains-that one endowed with prowess proceeded amain like an iron dart let go from a string.

sa: सत्त्वे वीर्ये न ते कश्चित् समो वानर विद्यते॥ यदवप्लुत्य विस्तीर्णं सागरं पुनरागतः। जीवितस्य प्रदाता नस्त्वमेको वानरोत्तम। ४६ ।। त्वत्प्रसादात् समेष्यामः सिद्धार्था राघवेण ह।
en: There is none, O monkey, that is like to you in strength and prowess. As having bounded over the spacious main, you had come back (here), you are, O excellent monkey, the only giver of our lives. By your grace it is that, our end attained, we shall meet with Rāghava.

sa: अङ्गदो वालिपुत्रस्तु बलेन महता वृतः। दक्षिणे बाधतां द्वारे महापार्श्वमहोदरौ॥
en: And, engirt by a mighty force, let Angada, son of Válī, resist Mahăpărśva and Mahodara at the Southern gate (thereof).

sa: विज्ञातं ते मया दूत वाक्यं यत्त्वं प्रभाषसे॥ नैव त्वमसि नैवासौ भ्रात्रा येनासि चोदितः। हितं नैष ममैतद्धि ब्रवीति धनरक्षकः॥ महेश्वरसखित्वं तु मूढः श्रावयते किल।
en: O messenger, I have learnt what you have uttered. Neither you nor this brother of mine by whom you have been despatched, (shall live); nor does the keeper of riches say what is for my good. And the fool makes me hear the circumstance of his having made friends with Mahesvara.

sa: हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि॥ विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम्।
en: O Maithili, do you behold the golden mount, which rose above the deep for affording a resting place to Hanumăn.

sa: श्रुत्वा तं भीमनिदिं शक्राशनिसमस्वनम्। वीक्षमाणाः दिशः सर्वा दुद्रुवुर्वानरा भृशम्॥
en: Hearing that dreadful uproar resembling the sound of Indra's thunder-bolt, the monkeys, casting their looks on all sides fled away.

sa: पुराणि स नदी शैलान्वनान्युपवनानि च। अतिक्रम्य मुहूर्तेन कैलासं गिरिमागमत्॥
en: Leaving behind cities and steams and hills and woods and groves, he in a moment came to the mountain Kailāśa.

sa: तस्य हस्ताद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं चापि सायकम्। निपपात सह प्राणैर्धश्यमानश्च जीवितात्॥
en: And from his hand who was deprived of his life fell down instantly on earth his shafts and bow. v

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वभिनिर्यान्तं सर्वे ते काननौकसः। उत्पेतुरभिसंक्रुद्धाः शिलाहस्ता युयुत्सवः॥
en: Beholding him thus proceed, the monkeys, inflamed with ire, desirous of fighting and with crags in their hands, moved on.

sa: स वज्र इव दुर्धर्षो वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः। कृतान्त इव चावार्यो न्यपतद्रावणोरसि॥
en: (That Brahma weapon) irrepressible as the thunder, dreadful as the Death and discharged by Rama, fell down on Ravana's breast.

sa: विज्ञाय तु मनस्तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः। स निवृत्याहवात्तस्मात्प्रविवेश पुरं ततः॥
en: Having read the intention of that high-souled Raghava, he retired from the battle-field and entered into the city of Lankā.

sa: तान्प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्तान्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान्। लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम ससर्ज चान्यानिशितान्पृषत्कान्॥
en: They suddenly severed like powerful serpents cut.off, Lanka's lord came under the away of passion, and discharged other whetted arrows.

sa: आसन्वर्षसहस्राणि तथा पुत्रसहस्रिणः। निरामया विशोकाश्च रामे राज्यं प्रशासति ॥
en: Rāma governing the kingdom, (people) lived for thousand years and had thousand children, they were freed from diseases and sorrow.

sa: कन्यया त्वेवमुक्तस्तु विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः। उवाच कैकसीं भूयः पूर्णेन्दुरिव रोहिणीम्॥
en: On being thus besought by the girl, Visravabest of ascetics, again addressed Kaikasi, like the full moon addressing Rohini.* *Hesperus.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो राक्षसेन्द्रेण धीमता परिक्रम्य ततः शीघ्रं निर्जगाम नृपालयात्॥
en: Thus accosted by the intelligent lord of the Raksasas, Dhumraksa, turning about, issued out of the abode of the king.

sa: रावणोऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य संज्ञां महाहवे। आददे निशितान्बाणाञ्जग्राह च महद्धनुः॥
en: The exceedingly powerful Răvaņa recovering his consciousness in the dread encounter, took up whetted shafts and seized a mighty bow.

sa: अनेन प्रेषिता ये च राक्षसा लघुविक्रमाः। राघवस्तीर्ण इत्येव प्रवृत्तिस्तैरिहाहता॥
en: Those Rākşasas of fleet vigour who had been despatched by this one, have brought the news that Rāghava has crossed.

sa: उत्तीर्य सागरं रामः सह वानरसेनया संनिविष्टः समुद्रस्य तीरमासाद्य दक्षिणम्॥
en: Having crossed over the ocean, along with the monkey-host, Rāma has encamped himself on the southern shore of the sea.

sa: अभ्यतिक्रम्य सौमित्रिं रावणः समितिंजयः। आससाद रणे रामं स्थितं शैलमिवापरम्॥
en: Surpassing thus the son of Sumitrā Rāvana, ever victorious in battle, confronted Rāma in the encounter, standing like another hill.

sa: ततश्चानुमताः सर्वे सुसंहृष्टा वनौकसः। मुदिताश्च ततस्ते च प्रनृत्यन्ति ततस्ततः॥
en: And thereupon those monkeys, beside themselves with joy for being allowed to drink honey began to dance hither and thither.

sa: अङ्गदस्य मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं वानरर्षभाः॥ साधु साध्विति संहृष्टा वानराः प्रत्यपूजयन्।
en: Hearing these words from Angada, the leading monkeys attained to an excess of delight and eulogized him again and again.

sa: विधवा हतपुत्राश्च क्रोशन्त्यो हतबान्धवाः। राक्षस्यः सह संगम्य दुःखार्ताः पर्यदेवयन्॥
en: The widows and those who had lost their children or kinsmen approached those Rākşasas and overwhelmed with grief bewailed piteously.

sa: अतिकायं त्रिशिरसं धूम्राक्षं च निशाचरम्। अतिक्रम्य महावीर्यान्कि प्रशंसथ रावणिम्॥
en: And wherefore, passing by Atikāya and Trisiras and Dhumraksa, that night-ranger-all endowed with exceeding powers, do you extol Ravana's son?

sa: पाणिभिनिहताः केचित् केचिज्जानुभिराहताः। प्रकृष्टाश्च तदा कामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः॥
en: Some had their arins broken, some had their knee-joints crushed and some of them were thrown up in the sky.

sa: सर्वतोऽग्नि समास्तीर्य शरपत्रैः सतोमरैः। छागस्य सर्वकृष्णस्य गलं जग्राह जीवतः॥
en: Spreading fire on all sides with śare leaves and Tomaras, (Indrajit) caught a living goat, all black, by the neck.

sa: दैवतानि च सर्वाणि चैत्यानि नगरस्य च। सुगन्धमाल्यैर्वादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः॥
en: Let all people being purified worship all the deities and altars of the city with fragrant garlands and diverse music.

sa: तथा निर्गच्छतस्तस्य रक्षसः सह राक्षसैः॥ बभूव सुमहानादः क्षोभयन्निव सागरम्।
en: As that Rākşasa was setting out along with the Rākṣasas, he set up mighty roars as if agitating the deep.

sa: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रत्युवाच विभीषणम्। अस्नात्वा द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं राक्षसेश्वर॥
en: Being thus addressed Vaidehi replied to Vibhisana, “O lord of Raksasas, without bathing even I wish to see my husband."

sa: तं भीमवेगा हरयो नाराचैः क्षतविक्षताः। अन्धकारे न ददृशुर्मेधैः सूर्यमिवावृतम्॥
en: The exceedingly vehement monkeys, cut and mangled with Nărăcas, saw him in the dark like the sun enveloped in clouds.

sa: पदातयश्च बहवो महासारा महाबलाः। अन्वयू राक्षसा भीमा भीमाक्षाः शस्त्रपाणयः॥
en: Countless footmen wondrous powerful and mighty and dreadful and fierce-sighted Räksasas, carrying weapons in their hands, went in his wake.

sa: तैः पतद्भिश्च बहुभिस्तयोः शरशतैः शितैः॥ दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव बभूवुः शरसंकुलाः।
en: In consequence of countless keen arrow alighting in hundreds, all sides and all the cardinal quarters were swarming with shafts.

sa: तौ तु रावणसंदिष्टौ भ्रातरौ शुकसारणौ। व्योमान्तरगतौ वीरौ प्रस्थितौ पश्चिमामुखौ॥
en: Being commanded by Rāvana, the two brothers, the heroic Suka and Sāraņa proceeded towards the west by the aerial way.

sa: ते तु रामेण बाणौधैः सर्वमर्मसु ताडिताः। युद्धादपसृतास्तत्र सावशेषायुषोऽभवन् ॥
en: And, pierced in their vitals with Rama's shafts, they, having only their lives left to them, disappeared from the field.

sa: तयोरथ महान्कालो व्यतीयाधुध्यमानयोः। न च तौ युद्धवैमुख्यं श्रमं चाप्यभिजग्मतुः॥
en: A great while did they fight; yet they neither turned away (from the fight), nor did they experience any exhaustion.

sa: बहुशश्चोदयामास भर्तारं मामनुव्रताम्। भार्या मम भवस्वेति प्रत्याख्यातो ध्रुवं मया॥
en: He did urge me much ever devoted to my lord saying Be you my wife; but forsooth I disregarded him.

sa: एवमुक्ता हेनुमता सीता धर्मपथे स्थिता। अब्रवीत्परमप्रीता बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा ॥
en: Being thus addressed by Hanuman Sītā, ever treading the paths of monkey, greatly delighted, replied with words suppressed by tears.

sa: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः परपुरंजयः। तथेति प्रतिजग्राह निषसादासने शुभे॥
en: Hearing the words of Bharata, Rāma the conqueror of enemies cities, saying, “So be it" sat on an excellent seat.

sa: स कृत्वा भ्रुकुटि क्रुद्धः किंचित्संरक्तलोचनः॥ जगाम सुमहाक्रोधं निर्दहनिव राक्षसान्।
en: Then the enraged Rāma with his eyes slightly red flew into a tremendous passion as if burning up the Rākşasas.

sa: इति ब्रवाणं संक्रुद्धः परुषं रावणात्मजम्। हेतुमद्वाक्यमर्थज्ञो लक्ष्मणः प्रत्युवाच ह॥
en: As Ravana's son was speaking thus harshly, Lakşmaņa conversant with the import of words, replied in a reasonable speech, saying.

sa: हनूमानपि तेजस्वी श्रीमान् पर्वतसंनिभः। क्षितावाविद्ध्य लालं ननाद च महाध्वनिम्॥
en: And the graceful and energetic Hanumān also, resembling a hill, flourishing his tail over the ground, sent up tremendous roars.

sa: अप्रकम्प्यो यथा स्थाणुश्चन्द्रे सौम्यत्वमीदृशम्। नेदृशाः पार्थिवाः पूर्व भवितारो नराधिप।७॥
en: You are stable like a stake, gentle like the moon. No king like you had flourished beforeno other shall follow.

sa: तमहं हेतुभिर्वाक्यैर्विविधैश्च न्यदर्शयम्। साधु निर्यात्यतां सीता रामायेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: With various well meaning words and reasonings I pointed out to him, the necessity of rendering back Sītā to Rāma.

sa: माल्यवन्तं स्थितं दृष्टवा माल्यवन्तमिवाचलम्। उवाच राक्षसेन्द्रं तं देवराजानुजो बली॥
en: Seeing Mālyavān resembling the mountain, Mālyavān, stay, the powerful younger brother of the sovereign of the celestials spoke to him.

sa: रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान्। प्रजघान हयानीलः प्रहस्तस्य महाबलः।४३।।
en: And wrought up with rage, the exceedingly strong and mighty Nila with a giant Sala slew the steeds of Prahasta.

sa: यदुक्तं कपिराजेन रावणावरजं प्रति। वाक्यं हेतुमदत्यर्थं भवद्भिरपि च श्रुतम्॥
en: You have all heard, the words well grounded in reason, the lord of monkeys has said, regarding Rāvana's younger brother.

sa: परित्रस्तो न संशयः। नहि रोचयते तात युद्धं युद्धविशारद ॥
en: Sure this Mahodara is affrighted at Rāma. Therefore, my child, O you versed in warfare, he does not relish battle.

sa: राज्यं चिरं कृत्वा वानराणां महेश्वरः। ततस्त्वक्षरजा नाम कालधर्मेण योजितः॥
en: The Śiva having ruled the country of Mongoloids for a long time, offered to Rkşarajā with the passage of time.

sa: हिरण्यनाभं शैलेन्द्रं काञ्चनं पश्य मैथिलि॥ विश्रमार्थं हनुमतो भित्त्वा सागरमुत्थितम्।
en: O Maithili, do you behold the golden mount, which rose above the deep for affording a resting place to Hanumăn.

sa: हरयस्तु विजानन्ति पार्वती ते महौषधी। संजीवकरणी दिव्यां विशल्यां देवनिर्मिताम्॥
en: The monkeys well know that mighty mountainous medicine-divine and capable of reviving the dead, and made by the deities themselves-visalya.

sa: अब्रवीच्च तदा वाक्यं जातक्रोधो विभीषणः। अन्तरिक्षगतः श्रीमान्धाता वै राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: There upon, rising up in the welkin, the graceful brother Vibhisana, worked up with ire, addressed the lord of Rāshasas.

sa: ततो लोकत्रयं जित्वा स्थाप्य नागान्सुरान्वशे। समुद्रममृतार्थं च मथिष्यामि रसालयम्॥
en: And conquering the three worlds, and bringing under subjection serpents and celestials I shall for ambrosia churn the nether regions.

sa: नन्दनं विबुधोद्यानं चित्रं चैत्ररथं यथा॥ अतिवृत्तमिवाचिन्त्यं दिव्यं रम्यश्रिया युतम्।
en: It was like the garden of Nandana or like that of Kubera or perhaps it surpassed the both in excellence.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। विवृत्य नयने क्रूर जानकीमन्ववैक्षत॥
en: Hearing those words of Sītā, Rāvana, the lord of Rāksasas, whirling his grim eyes, looked towards the daughter of Janaka.

sa: सुग्रीवेणाभिसंदिष्टा हरयः कामरूपिणः॥ दिक्षु सर्वासु तां देवीं विचिन्वन्तः सहस्रशः।
en: And by Sugrīva's decree, thousands of monkeys, wearing shapes at will, have been searching that worshipful dame in various directions.

sa: रक्षांसि निहनिष्यन्तः पुर्यामस्यां न संशयः। असम्पातं करिष्यन्ति पतन्तः कङ्कवाससः॥
en: And covered with Kanka leaves they shall undoubtedly cover the whole city and devastate it by destroying all the Rākṣasas.

sa: अथ मेघप्रतीकाशं कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम्। विभीषणस्य च तथा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः॥
en: Then that inighty monkey entered into the abode of Kumbhakarna, resembling a mass of clouds; and thereafter that of Vibhisana;

sa: अयोध्यायाश्च ते मार्ग प्रवृत्तिं भरतस्य च। निवेदयिष्यति प्रीतो निषादाधिपतिर्मुहः॥
en: Guha, the lord of Nişādhas, delighted, shall inform you of the way to Ayodhyā and the well being of Bharata.

sa: साऽथ दृष्ट्वा हरिश्रेष्ठं विनीतवदवस्थितम्। मैथिली चिन्तयामास विस्मयं परमं गता॥
en: And observing that foremost of the monkeys, sitting humbly, that daughter of the king of Mithilā, again greatly amazed, thought.

sa: तामशोकस्य शाखां तु विमुक्त्वा शोककर्शिता । तस्यामेवानवद्याङ्गी धरण्यां समुपाविशत्॥
en: And leaving off the Asoka branch, that one having a blameless person, overwhelmed with grief, sat down on the earth.

sa: निष्क्रान्ते राक्षसेन्द्रे तु पुनरन्तःपुरं गते। राक्षस्यो भीमरूपास्ताः सीतां समभिदुद्रुवुः॥
en: And after that lord of Rākşasas had gone away and entered his inner apartment, the hideous Rākşasīs drew near Sitä.

sa: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतानिशाचरान्। उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात्॥
en: Learning that these night-rangers had obtained boons, Sumāli with his followers, casting off fear, rose up from the nether regions.

sa: दूषणस्य च हन्तारौ खरस्य च महाबलौ। सादितौ मामकैर्बाणैतिरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: The brothers-Rāma and Lakşmaņa, possessed of great strength, who had slain Khara and Dūşaņa, are themselves slain with my shafts.

sa: इन्द्रजित्त्वात्मनः कर्म तौ शयानौ समीक्ष्य च। उवाच परमप्रीतो हर्षयन्सर्वराक्षसान्॥
en: And Indrajit, seeing his own feat and them lying at length, spoke in excess of joy, gladdening all the Rākşasas.

sa: स लवयित्वा प्राकारं गिरुकूटोपमो महान्। निर्ययौ नगरातूर्णं कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः॥
en: Having leapt over the wall, the exceedingly powerful and gigantic Kumbhakarņa resembling a mountain-summit, speedily went out of the city.

sa: यूपाक्षमभिसंक्रुद्धो मैन्दो वानरपुङ्गवः। पीडयामास बाहुभ्यां पणत स हतः क्षितौ॥
en: And fired with wrath, Mainda-foremost of monkeys-grasped Yupaksa with his arms; and that one dropt down dead on the earth.

sa: अथ सुप्तस्य रामस्य प्रहस्तेन प्रमाथिना। असक्तं कृतहस्तेन शिरश्छिन्नं महासिना॥
en: While Räma was sleeping, the furious Prahasta by means of a mighty falchion, with speed cut off his head clean.

sa: जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं रक्षसां वशमागता॥
en: Breathe shall I only for a month, beyond that I shall never live, subject as I am to the demons.'

sa: संनिविष्टः समुद्रस्य पीड्य तीरमथोत्तरम्। बलेन महता रामो व्रजत्यस्तं दिवाकरे॥
en: And on the sun have set, Rama stationed himself with his mighty army, oppressing the northern shore (of the sea).

sa: तां तु दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतां तृणबिन्दुरथाब्रवीत्। किं त्वमेतत्त्वसदृशं धारयस्यात्मनो वपुः॥
en: Seeing her in this condition, Triņabindu said, "Wherefore is the person that you bear unlike what it used to be?'

sa: छिन्नं ते सर्वथा मूलं दर्पश्च निहतो मया॥ व्यसनेनात्मनः सीते मम भार्या भविष्यसि। विसृजैतां मतिं मूढे किं मृतेन करिष्यसि॥
en: Your roots have been completely severed, and your pride has been destroyed by me. In consequence of this calamity, O Sītā, you shall become my wife. O foolish (girl), renounce this idea. What will you do with that is dead?

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह॥ संस्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रीगणः परिसान्त्व्यताम्।
en: In the meantime Rama said to Vibhrsana, “Do you perform the funeral ceremonies of your brother and console his wives."

sa: महालतानां दामानि व्यधमत्तरसा कपिः। यथा प्रावृषि वेगेन मेघजालानि मारुतः॥
en: That monkey with his vehemence scattered the clusters of shrubs, like the wind violently scattering clouds in the rainy reason.

sa: शशास चैव तान्सर्वान्राक्षसान्स महाबलान्। राक्षसा गच्छताद्यैव सिंहनादं च नादयन्।॥
en: Setting up leonine roars, he commanded all those highly powerful Raksasas, saying, "Do you go this very day for battle."

sa: लब्धसंज्ञो मुहूर्तेन अयोध्याधिपतिस्तदा। तं मन्त्रिभिः शत्रु पूज्यमानं निशाचरैः॥ जातकोपो दुराधर्षश्चन्द्रार्कसदृशद्युतिः। महता शरवर्षेण पातयद्राक्षसं बलम्॥ चापस्यैव निनादेन तस्य बाणरवेण च। संचचाल ततः सैन्यमुद्भूत इव सागरः॥ ताद्धमभवद्धोरं नरराक्षससंकुलम्। अथाविष्टो महात्मानौ नरराक्षससत्तमौ॥ कार्मुकासिधरौ वीरौ वीरासनगतौ तदा। मांधाता रावणं चैव रावणश्चैव तं नृपम्॥ क्रोधेन महताविष्टौ शरवर्ष मुमोचतुः। तौ परस्परसंक्षोभात्प्रहारैः क्षतविक्षतौ॥
en: Regaining his sense in a moment the king of Ayodhyā beheld his enemy worshipped by the courtiers and night-rangers. He was instantly worked up with ire; and assuming a person resplendent like that of the sun and the moon he began to slay the Räksasa host with a dreadful downpour of shafts. With his arrows and the noise thereof the entire Räksasa army were overwhelmed like the agitated deep. Thereupon there arose a dreadful conflict between men and demons. And those two heroic, high-souled and foremost of men and Rakşasas seated on warriors' seats and holding bow and daggers entered (the field).

sa: निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठं यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति नः। तेषु तेष्वभिपनेषु लक्षयाम्यप्रदक्षिणम्॥
en: And bad omens fast sprang up before us. And on these occurring, I perceived that things would go against us.

sa: एषैवाशंसते लङ्कां स्वेनानीकेन मर्दितुम्। श्वेतो रजतसंकाशश्चपलो भीमविक्रमः॥ बुद्धिमान्वानरः शूरस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। तूर्णं सुग्रीवमागम्य पुनर्गच्छति वानरः॥ विभजन्वानरी सेनामनीकानि प्रहर्षयन्।
en: With his own army alone, the silver-hued Śveta of dreadful prowess hopes to subdue Lanka. Marshalling his monkey-forces and cheering up his soldiers, that intelligent monkey, famed over the three regions, having speedily met with Sugrīva, is retracting his steps.

sa: वनान्युपवनानीह लङ्कायाः काननानि च। सर्वतो गृहमुख्यानि द्रष्टुमागमनं हि मे॥
en: I come forsooth to see the woods and groves and gardens of Lankā here, as well as her principle edifices.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी।। बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: That host protected by Rāma, Lakşmaņa and Sugrīva, shall become exceedingly hard to combat even by the Asuras and gods.

sa: तां हतां वानरेणाशु पतितां वीक्ष्य सिंहिकाम्। भूतान्याकाशचारीणि तमूचुः प्लवगोत्तमम्॥
en: And seeing Sinhikā speedily slain by the monkey, and fallen, creatures ranging the sky addressed that foremost of monkeys, saying,

sa: तं तु शोकपरिघुनं रामं दशरथात्मजम्। उवाच वचनं श्रीमान्सुग्रीवः शोकनाशनम्॥
en: Then the graceful Sugrīva spoke words capable of soothing sorrow, to Dasaratha's son, Rāma, who was wrought up with grief.

sa: नहि पश्याम्यहं कंचित्रिषु लोकेषु राघव। गृहीतधनुषो यस्ते तिष्ठेदभिमुखो रणे॥
en: Find I none in the three worlds, O Rāghava, who can stay in fight before you equipped with your bow,

sa: इति प्रतिसमादिश्य राक्षसेन्द्रः पुनः पुनः॥ काममन्युपरीतात्मा जानकी प्रति गर्जत।
en: And having ordered thus again and again, that lord of Rākşasas, stricken with amour and ire, addressed Sītā, roaring fiercely.

sa: ततो रक्षा मुहूर्तेन चेतनां लभ्य चोत्थितम्। लजशवनतीभूयं बलिर्वाक्यमुवाच ह॥
en: Regaining his sense that Rākṣasa rose up in a moment and lowered his head in shame. Bali said to him.

sa: सागरौघनिभं भीमं दृष्ट्वा बाणादितं बलम्। मार्गते जाम्बवन्तं च हनूमान्सविभीषणः॥
en: And surveying that host worsted, dreadful like the surges of the sea, Hanumăn and Vibhīşaņa began to search for Jāmbavān.

sa: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत्सुमुखोद्गतम्। उवाच राघवो वाक्यं नीलं सेनापतिं तदा॥
en: Hearing Vibhīşaņa's words informed with reason and tending to the good (of the monkeys), Rāghava then addressed general Nila, saying.

sa: समाप्ते नियमे तस्य ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः। पपात पुष्पवर्षं च तुष्टवुश्चापि देवताः।७।।
en: When he had completed (his term of restriction), swarms of apsaras danced, and blossoms showered, and the deities hymned (him).

sa: ते प्रासैः परिधैः शूलैर्मुसलैः शक्तितोमरैः। पुष्पकं समधर्षन्त शूराः शतसहस्रशः॥ तस्यासनानि प्रासादन्वेदिकास्तोरणानि च। पुष्पकस्य बभञ्जुस्ते शीघ्रं मधुकरा इव ॥
en: And those heroes by hundreds and by thousands assailed (Puspaka) with prāsas, and bludgeons, and darts and maces, and spears and tomaras. And swiftly swarming like bees, they began to break the seats, blocks, daises and gateways (of the car.)

sa: जलक्लिन्नेन हस्तेन तयोर्ने। विमृज्य च। शोकसंपीडितमना रुरोद विललाप च॥
en: Washing their eyes with water, he, with his mind overpowered with grief, began to weep and broke out into lamentation.

sa: तमवध्यं मघवता यमेन वरुणेन वा। प्रेक्ष्य भीमाक्षमायन्तं वानरा विप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Seeing that fierce-eyed one, incapable of being vanquished by Maghavān or Varuņa or Yama, the monkeys began to fly away.

sa: स बाणव(रभिवृष्यमाणो धारानिपातानिव तानचिन्त्य। समीक्षमाणः परमाद्भुतश्री रामस्ततो लक्ष्मणमित्युवाच ॥
en: And showered with those vollies of arrows, Rāma, without heeding that discharge resembling a very downpour, reflecting, spoke to Laksmana.

sa: अर्दयामास संक्रुद्धः कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः। स शरैः सूर्यसंकाशैः सुमुक्तै शीघ्रगामिभिः॥
en: In that terrific conflict, he agitated the monkey-hosts with swift-speeding shafts, resembling the Sun himself, deftly discharged (from his bow).

sa: तस्मात्क्षिप्रं सहास्माभिस्तुल्यो भवतु राघव। विभीषणो महाप्राज्ञः सखित्वं चाभ्युपैतु नः॥
en: And let the greatly wise Vibhīşaņa, O Rāghava, be placed on an equal footing with us and gain our friendship.

sa: सा स्म याति दिवारानं महती हरिवाहिनी॥ प्रहृष्टमुदिताः सर्वे सुग्रीवेणाभिपालिताः। वानरास्त्वरिता यान्ति सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। प्रमोक्षयिषवः सीतां मुहूर्त क्वापि नावसन्॥
en: Thus the enormous monkey host went on day and night. And all those monkeys, delighted, guided by Sugrīva, and taking delight in battle, went on speedily. And they did not take rest even for a moment, desirous of rescuing Sītā.

sa: ते वध्यमानाः समरे वानराः पादपायुधाः। अभ्यवर्षन्त सहसा रावणिं शैलपापैः॥
en: Trembling in the encounter, those monkeys armed with trees at once began to shower rocks and trees on Ravana's son.

sa: दीर्घमुष्णं च निःश्वस्य समुद्रीक्ष्य च लक्ष्मणम्। उवाच वचनं वीरस्तकालहितमात्मनः॥
en: Sighing hot and long, and looking at Laks maņa, that hero spoke words fraught with his good at that time.

sa: कदा शोकमिमं घोरं मैथिलीविप्रयोगजम्। सहसा विप्रमोक्ष्यामि वासः शुक्लेतरं यथा॥
en: When shall I renounce this my sorrow arising out of Maithili's separation, like to one casting off his soiled clothes?

sa: अग्निष्टेष्वग्निशालासु तथा ब्रह्मस्थलीषु च। सरीसृपाणि दृश्यन्ते हव्येषु च पिपीलिकाः॥
en: Reptiles are discovered in kitchens, sacrificial fire-chambers, and the places of Vaidika recitations; and ants (are found) in clarified butter.

sa: वायसाः सङ्घशः क्रूरा व्याहरन्ति समन्ततः। समवेताश्च दृश्यन्ते विमानाग्रेषु सङ्घशः॥
en: And crows in numbers emit harsh cries on all sides, and are seen in swarms at the tops of edifices.

sa: विमलं चातपत्रं च प्रगृहीतमशोभत ॥ पाण्डुरं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पूर्णस्ताराधिपो यथा।
en: The spotless white umbrella of the lord of Rākşasa, being raised up, looked beautiful like the Moon at her full.

sa: प्रदक्षिणं तु तां कृत्वा रावणः परमाद्भुताम्। प्रविवेशमहाघोरं गुप्तं बहुविधैर्बलैः॥
en: Having gone round this wonderful (cow), Rāvaņa entered the exceedingly dreadful abode of Varuna) guarded by various kinds of forces.

sa: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो रावणस्य रथोपरि। वाता मण्डलिनस्तीवा व्यपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः॥
en: The god poured down showers of blood on the car of Rāvana; and a violent tornado eddied on his right.

sa: विष्णुना दैत्यघातैश्च गन्धर्वोरंगधर्षणैः। त्वया समं विमर्दैश्च भृशं हि परितोषितः॥
en: And even as Vişnu had pleased me by destroying the Daityas, you pleased me by harassing the Gandharvas and serpents.

sa: तेन तन्मरुकान्तारं पृथिव्यां किल विश्रुतम्। निपातितः शरो यत्र वज्राशनिसमप्रभः॥
en: The place where the arrow resembling the thunder-bolt and vajra in splendour, alighted, has been celebrated on earth as Marukāntāra.

sa: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च राघव। स्वभादे सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वतं मार्गमाश्रिताः॥
en: O Rāghava, earth, air, sky, water and light, these, O mild one, retaining their eternal course, maintain their (respective) nature.

sa: एष रावणवीर्येण लक्ष्मणः पतितो भुवि। सर्पवच्चेष्टते वीरो मम शोकमुदीरयन्॥
en: This heroic Lakşmaņa brought down to the earth by the prowess of Rāvana, Leith like a serpent, enhancing my sorrow.

sa: मोक्षधर्माश्च निखिला याथातथ्येन ते श्रुताः॥ असकृच्चापि संदेहाश्छिन्नास्ते कामजा मया।
en: You have faithfully listened to the entire doctrine of salvation; and I have repeatedly removed your misgivings originating from desire.

sa: शिखण्डी पाण्डुपुत्राणां नेता सप्तचमूपतिः। बभूव रक्षितो धीमान् श्रीमता सत्यसाचिना॥
en: Highly intelligent Shikhandin, protected by the blessed Arjuna, became the leader of the seven divisions of the sons of Pandu.

sa: प्रयोजनं चापि निवासकारणे। न विद्यते मे त्वदृते नृपात्मज। स्थिता हि पृथ्वी तव पार्थ शासने गुरोः सुवृत्तस्य युधिष्ठिरस्य च॥
en: And, O prince, Partha (son of Pritha) when this earth has come under your control and that of the worshipful Yudhishthira of excellent character, there no longer remains any need for my staying here except for my love for you.

sa: संजयो नृपतेर्नेता समेषु विषमेषु च। गान्धार्याश्च पृथा चैव चक्षुरासीदनिन्दिता॥
en: Sanjaya acted as the guide on even and uneven land. The faultless Pritha, O king, became the eye of Gandhari.

sa: सम्यग्युक्त्वा स आत्मानमात्मन्येव प्रतिष्ठते। विनिवृत्तजरादुःख सुखं स्वपिति चापि सः॥
en: Having adequately concentrated his soul, he lives firmly himself. Pruning off decrepitude and pain and pleasure, he sleeps at case.

sa: अर्च्यते वै विमानस्थः कामभोगैश्च सेव्यते। फलं पद्मशतप्रख्यं महाकल्पं दशाधिकम्॥
en: He enjoys such happiness upto the period of one hundred Padma years as longer as ten Mahakalpa and four ages.

sa: तद्वचः पूजयित्वा तु तथेत्याह स पार्थिवः। यथोपपन्नमाहारं तस्मै प्रादाज्जनाधिप॥
en: Receiving these words with respect, the king said,-So be it!-and then offered to the Rishi food of the proper kind.

sa: आवाहाश्च विवाहाश्च यज्ञाश्चान्नमृते तथा। निवर्तन्ते नरश्रेष्ठ ब्रह्म चात्र प्रलीयते॥
en: Invitation and marriages and sacrifices all cease for want of food. The very Vedas disappear when there is no food.

sa: यावन्त इह शक्येरं स्तावन्तॊऽशान् प्रकल्पयेत्। अव्यक्तान् व्यक्तरूपानं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: One should understand as many parts, unmanifest and manifest, by hundreds and thousands, as one is capable of comprehending here.

sa: प्रज्ञानं शौचमेवेह शरीरस्य विशेषतः। तथा निष्किंचनत्वं च मनसश्च प्रसन्नता॥
en: Knowledge is said to form the especial purity of the body. So also freedom from desire, and cheerfulness of mind.

sa: आराधयामास च तं कृतवीर्यात्मजो मुनिम्। न्यमन्त्रयत संतुष्टो द्विजश्चैनं वरैस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Indeed, the of Kritavirya thus worshipped that great ascetic who, becoming pleased with him, asked him to solicit three boons.

sa: अयं चिरोषितो राजन् वासुदेवः प्रतापवान्। भवन्तं समनुज्ञाप्य पितरं द्रष्टुमिच्छति॥
en: Highly powerful Vasudeva here, O sing, is long absent from home. He wishes, with your permission, to see his sire.

sa: सहदेववचः श्रुत्वा द्रौपदी योषितां वरा। उवाच देवी राजानमभिपूज्याभिनन्द्य च॥
en: Hearing these words of Sahadeva, queen Draupadi, that foremost of all women duly honoring the king, said, with proper salutations,

sa: श्राद्धं संकल्पयामास जमदग्निः पुरा किला होमधेनुस्तमागाच्च स्वयमेव दुदोह ताम्॥
en: Formerly, the Rishi Jamadagni desired to perform a Shraddha. His Homa-Cow came to him and the Rishi milked her himself.

sa: शक्ता ह्यसि महीं कृत्स्नां वोढुं धारयितुं तथा। न हि ते किंचिदप्राप्यमन्यतो धारणादृते॥ सा वह्निना वार्यमाणा देवैरपि सरिद्वरा। समुत्ससर्ज तं गर्भं मेरौ गिरिवरे तदा॥
en: You are, indeed, capable of bearing the entire Earth. You will gain nothing by not holding this energy. That foremost of rivers, though thus dissuaded by the deity of fire as also by all the other celestials, cast off the seed on the breast of Meru, that foremost of all mountains.

sa: वाक्यानि सुमहार्थानि परितप्यामि दुर्मतिः॥ उक्तवान् विदुरो यन्मां धर्मात्मा दिव्यदर्शनः।
en: The virtuous Vidura, gifted with divine insight, had told me, your family will be extinct for the sins of Duryodhana.

sa: ज्येष्ठं पितृसमं चापि भ्रातरं योऽवमन्यते। सोऽपि मृत्युमुपागम्य क्रौञ्चयोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: He who disregards his eldest brother who is like a father, has, after death, to take birth as a crane.

sa: तस्मिन् संशोषिते देशे भद्रामादाय वारिपः। अददाच्छरणं गत्वा भार्यामाङ्गिरसाय वै॥
en: When that rcgion became dry, he repaired to Angirasaa, taking with him Utathya's wife, and made her over to him.

sa: यथा कर्मसमाविष्टः काममन्युसमावृतः। नरो गर्भ प्रविशति तच्चापि शृणु चोत्तरम्॥
en: Hear then how the Individual Soul, cquipped with all his deeds and overwhelmed with lust and anger, enters the womb.

sa: शतं वर्षसहस्राणां मोदते स दिवि प्रभो। काञ्चीनूपुरशब्देन सुप्तश्चैव प्रबोध्यते॥
en: He is roused from his bed every morning by the sound of the Kanchis and the Nupuras of those ladies.

sa: सोऽशक्नुवन् विशेषाय समाहूय बृहस्पतिम्। उवाचेदं वचो देवैः सहितो हरिवाहनः॥
en: And unable to control him, he riding on the horse, along with the celestials summoning Brihaspati, spoke to him thus.

sa: पाण्डवाश्चैव ते सर्वे भृशं शोकपरायणाः। शोचन्तो मातरं वृद्धामूर्नातिचिरं पुरे॥
en: The Pandavas also, greatly stricken with grief, bewailed for their old mother, and could not live in their city long.

sa: ततः प्रसादयामासुरुमां रुद्रं च ते सुराः। बभूव स तदा बाहुर्बलहन्तुर्यथा पुरा॥ स चापि ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा दुर्वासा नाम वीर्यवान्। द्वारवत्यां मम गृहे चिरं कालमुपावसन्॥
en: The celestials also began to sing the praises of both Uma and Rudra. The arm (which had been paralysed) of the destroyer of Vala then became restored to its former state. That Mahadeva, taking birth as the highly energetic Brahmana Durvasas, lived for a long time at Dvaravati in my house.

sa: कुतोवायं प्रश्वसिति उच्छ्वसित्यपि वा पुनः। कं च देशमधिष्ठाय तिष्ठेत्यात्मायमात्मनि॥
en: How does this one inhale and again, exhale? Staying upon what particular part does the Soul live in the body?

sa: गान्धारी चैव कुन्ती च द्रौपदी सात्वती तथा। स्त्रियश्चान्यास्तथान्याभिः सहोपविविशुस्ततः॥
en: Gandhari, Kunti and Draupadi, and she of the Satvata race, and other ladies of the royal household also sat down.

sa: इमं धर्मपथं नारी पालयन्ती समाहिता। अरुन्धतीव नारीणां स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: That woman who with rapt attention, follows her duty, receives profuse honors in the celestial region like a second Arundhati.

sa: अलर्क उवाच दृष्ट्वा रूपाणि बहुशस्तान्येव प्रतिगृध्यति। तस्माच्चक्षुर्हनिष्यामि निशितैः सायकैरहम्॥
en: Alarka said Secing many colours, the eye longs for them only. Hence, I shall destroy the eye with sharp-pointed arrows.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति कौरव्ये धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। वासुदेवो वरः पुंसामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When king Yudhishthira the just of Kuru's race said so, Vasudeva, that foremost of men, said these words (in reply).

sa: समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं काशिपुर्या स्वयंवरे॥ विजित्यैकरथेनैव कन्याश्चायं जहार ह।
en: At the Svayamvara at Kashi, he defeated on a single car the assembled Kshatriyas and carried away the three princesses.

sa: पृथामेव च शोचामि या पुत्रैश्वर्यमृद्धिमत्। उत्सृज्य सुमहद् दीप्तं वनवासमरोचयत्॥
en: I grieve, however, for Pritha who, renouncing the blazing prosperity of her sons, became desirous of living in the forest.

sa: दृष्ट्वैव सागरं वीक्ष्य सीदन्तीं कपिवाहिनीम्। समाश्वास्य महाबाहुर्योजनानां शतं प्लुतः॥
en: When the monkey host lost heart beholding the ocean, Hanumān, consoling crossed over the deep extending over a hundred leagues.

sa: स गत्वा मनसा पूर्वमशोकवनिकां शुभाम्। उत्तरं चिन्तयामास वानरो मारुतात्मजः॥
en: Having mentally entered the Asoka wood, that monkey, son to the Wind-god, reflected as to what he should do next.

sa: नागैरभ्याहता: केचित् सरथा रथिनोऽपतन्। व्यद्रवन्त रणे वीरा द्राव्यमाणा मदोत्कटैः॥
en: Some car-warriors, struck by elephants, were deprived of their cars. Dispersed by those infuriate animals, other brave heroes ran away.

sa: तदप्रियममित्रघ्नो वचनं मरणोपमम्। श्रुत्वा न विव्यथे रामः कैकेयी चेदमब्रवीत्।।।
en: Hearing these unpleasant words like to death, Rama, the destroyer of foes, was not pained, and spoke thus to Kaikeyī.

sa: ततः सुपर्णबहुला भङ्क्त्वा शाखां सुपुष्पिताम्॥ सालस्यास्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद सराघवः।
en: Then spreading a beautifully blossoming spray of Sala, full of foliage, Sugriva made an awning and sat down with Rāghava.

sa: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभिस्तुष्टैर्हष्टैः स्वलंकृतैः। सुसंवृतः पिशाचानां गणैर्देवगणैस्तथा॥ क्रीडन् भाति तदा देवैरभिषिक्तश्च पावकिः। अभिषिक्तं महासेनमपश्यन्त दिवौकसः॥ विनिहत्य तमः सूर्यं यथेहाभ्युदितं तथा। अथैनमभ्ययुः सर्वा देवसेनाः सहस्रशः॥
en: Surrounded by the well dressed Apsaras, by many gay and happy looking Pishachas and by the celestial, that son of Agni sported in all his grandeur. To the dwellers of heaven, the installed Skanda looked like the sun rising after the darkness has passed away. Then thousands of the celestial forces.

sa: ग्रन्थस्यार्थस्य पृष्टः संस्तादृशो वक्तुमर्हति। यथा तत्त्वाभिगमनादर्थं तस्य स विन्दति॥
en: Asked about the meaning of a text, one should communicate that meaning which he has understood by a careful study.

sa: ततः कृपः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सोऽतिविद्धो महारथः। व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे शिखण्डिनमथो द्विजः॥
en: Then the Brahmana Kripa, a mighty carwarrior, piercing heavily with sharp arrows, deprived Shikhandin of his horses, charioteer and car.

sa: तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा प्राणानुत्सृज्य भारत। नारदेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो लोकान् प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमान्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, a man, bathing in that Tirtha, obtains excellent regions (after death) at the command of Narada.

sa: सरथश्छादितो राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नो न दृश्यते। मेधैरिव परिच्छन्नो भास्करो जलधारिभिः॥
en: O king, thus covered along with his car Dhristadyumna became invisible like the sun enshrouded by clouds surcharged with water.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मावर्तं नरोत्तमः॥ ब्रह्मावर्ते नरः स्नात्वा ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्नुयात्।
en: O virtuous king, one should then go to Brahmavarta. Bathing in the Brahmavarta a man, obtains the regions of Brahma.

sa: नानुतिष्ठसि धर्मार्थो न कामे चापि वर्तसे। इन्द्रियार्थाननादृत्य मुक्तश्चरसि साक्षिवत्॥
en: Regardless of all sensuous enjoyments, you move like an emancipated self, only witnessing everything, (but never taking part in anything).

sa: भो भो विदुर राजाहं दयितस्ते युधिष्ठिरः। इति ब्रुवन्नरपतिस्तं यत्नादभ्यधावत॥
en: He said aloud, 'O Vidura, O Vidura, I am king Yudhishthira, your favourite-Exclaiming thus, Yudhishthira, with great exertion, followed Vidura.

sa: पांसवोऽपि कुरुक्षेत्रे वायुना समुदीरिताः। अपि दुष्कृतकर्माणं नयन्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: The very dust of Kurukshetra carried by the wind leads even the man of sinful deeds to the highest state.

sa: आचार्या वै कारुणिकाः प्राज्ञाश्चापापदर्शिनः। नैते महाभये प्राप्ते सम्प्रष्टव्याः कथंचन॥
en: Preceptors are wise, virtuous and very kind to all creatures but they should not be consulted in hours of danger.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणम्। वासुदेवं महाबाहुमभ्यभाषत कौरवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this much to Dhritarashtra of great wisdom, the Kuru chief then addressed Vasudeva of great arms.

sa: वालिना भग्नदर्पस्तु सुग्रीवो मन्दविक्रमः॥ वालिनं प्रति सामर्षो दर्शयामास राघवम्।
en: And having his pride crushed down by Väli and strength greatly reduced, Sugrīva in anger pointed him out to Rāma.

sa: यः स देवमनुष्याणां भयमुत्पादयिष्यति। त्रयाणामेव लोकानां सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: He shall always strike all men, indeed, the inhabitants of the three worlds, 'vith fear. I tell you the truth.

sa: साधकानि सदा पुंसां न जातिर्न कुलं नृप। अरिष्ट एष भ्राता भीमसेनो महाबलः। स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महाराज गमिष्यामि दिवं पुनः॥
en: O king and not race nor (illustrious) family, are the means by which persons must attain salvation. May your younger brother Bhimasena be all hail; and O mighty monarch, may you be happy. I shall now go to heaven again.

sa: स तु रुदैर्महाघोरैः संगम्याथ निशाचरः। प्रयुद्धस्तैश्च संग्रामे क्षतः शस्त्रैर्निरन्तरम्॥
en: Thereupon the night-ranger engaged with the highly powerful Rudra and was wounded, in the conflict, with incessant strokes of weapons.

sa: उवाच देवकीपुत्रः प्रीयमाणो धनंजयम्॥ एष शान्तनवो भीष्मः सेनयोरन्तरे स्थितः।
en: That son of Devaki, joyfully addressed Dhananjaya saying. “Yonder is Bhishma, the son of Shantanu staying between the two armies.

sa: मद्रराजरथं तूर्णं छादयामासतुः क्षणात्। स छाद्यमानो बहुभिः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Waxing irascible and becoming formidable in battle, covered the king of the Madras (with shafts). Covered with innumerable straightjointed arrows.

sa: उपर्युपरि सा नूनं सागरं क्रमतस्तदा। विचेष्टमाना पतिता समुद्रे जनकात्मजा॥
en: For certain, while (Ravana) was soaring higher and higher, Janaka's daughter, rolling (on the car), dropped down into the sea.

sa: अश्वानां हेषमाणानां गजानां चैव बुंहताम्। सिंहनादश्च शूराणां श्रूयते सुमहानयम्॥
en: Loud also is the neighing of their steeds and the grunting of their elephants and the roaring of their warriors.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥ आदित्यस्याश्रमो यत्र तेजोराशेर्महात्मनः। तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा विभावसुम्॥ आदित्यलोकं व्रजति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: Where there is the hermitage of Aditya, the illustrious deity of great effulgence, (there is also another Tirtha). Bathing in it and worshipping there the god of light a man, goes to the region of Soma and saves his race.

sa: ततो रामानुजः क्रुद्धः कालस्यास्र सुदारुणम्। संवत नाम भरतो गन्धर्वेष्वभ्यचोदयत्॥
en: There upon enraged Bharata, Rāma's younger brother, discharged a dreadful arrow named Samvarata resembling the fire of dissolution against Gandharvas.

sa: उदयास्तमने नित्यं पुर्यां तस्यां दिवाकरः। व्यदृश्यतासकृत् पुम्भिः कबन्धैः परिवारितः॥
en: The Sun, whether when rising or setting over that city, seemed to be surrounded by headless trunks of human beings.

sa: इमां च नगरी सद्यः प्रतियाते धनञ्जये॥ प्राकाराट्टालकोपेतां समुद्रः प्लावयिष्यति।
en: This city of Dvaravati, after Arjuna's departure, will, with its walls and edifices, be speedily swallowed up by the ocean.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच तयोः संलग्नयोर्युद्धे रुद्रनारायणात्मनोः॥ उद्विग्नाः सहसा कृत्स्नाः सर्वे लोकास्तदाभवन्।
en: The Blessed and Holy One said When Rudra and Narayana thus fought all the universe became suddenly stricken with anxiety.

sa: ब्राहाण उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। कार्तवीर्यस्य संवादं समुद्रस्य च भाविनि॥
en: The Brahmana said About it is cited the ancient story O lady, of the discourse between Kartavirya and the Ocean.

sa: नूनमापूर्यमाणायाः सरय्वा वर्धते रयः। मां समीक्ष्य समायान्तमयोध्याया इव स्वनः॥
en: The river Saraju is now brimful with water. Seeing me return as if Ayodhyā herself is making a delightful noise.

sa: ततोऽभिवाद्य त्वरिताः पादौ रामस्य मूर्धभिः। तस्थुः समाहिताः सर्वे रामस्त्वश्रूण्यवर्तयत्॥
en: Then having approached him quickly, and saluted his feet they all anxiously sat there. Rāma also wiped off his tears.

sa: तं पौष्यः प्रत्युवाच यस्मात्त्वमप्यदुष्टमन्नं दूषयसि तस्मात्त्वमनपत्यो भविष्यसीति तमुत्तङ्कः प्रत्युवाच॥
en: Paushya replied, "As you impute uncleanliness to the food which is clean, you will be without a child," Uttanka said,

sa: नीलमेघाश्रिता विद्युत् स्फुरन्ती प्रतिभाति मे। स्फुरन्ती रावणस्याङ्के वैदेहीव तपस्विनी॥
en: Methinks, the lighting, shining by the violet clouds, is appearing like to the poor Vaidehi at the lap of Rävaņa.

sa: एषा धर्मपरिक्लिष्टा नववारिपरिप्लुता। सीतेव शोकसंतप्ता मही वाष्पं विमुञ्चति ॥
en: The earth, afflicted with perspiration and filled with new water, is emitting forth vapour like to Sitā racked with sorrow.

sa: विश्वकर्मसुतो वीरो नलः प्लवगसत्तमः। विक्रान्तो वेगवानत्र वसुपुत्रः स दुर्धरः॥
en: The heroic Nalabest of monkeys, is the son of Viśvakarmă. And powerful and impetuous, Durdhara is the son of Vasu.

sa: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रसादो रघुनन्दन। यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव ॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, such is the power of a horse-sacrifice. O honourable king, therefore, you may perform this sacrifice.

sa: शेषास्तु पाण्डवा राजन् नैवोचुः किंचिदप्रियम्। दूतश्चापि यथावृत्तं धार्तराष्ट्र न्यवेदयत्॥
en: O king, the other Pandavas did not say anything unpleasant. The messenger on his return told everything to Dhritarashtra's son.

sa: तां पतन्तीं वरारोहां भज्यमानां लतामिव। नकुलः समभिद्रुत्य परिजग्राह वीर्यवान्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of women falling down like a twisted creeper, the greatly strong Nakula ran forward and supported her.

sa: भीष्मेण सह मा योत्सीः शिष्येणेति वचोऽब्रवीत्। स च तामाह याचन्तीं भीष्ममेव निवर्तय। न च मे कुरुते काममित्यहं तमुपागमम्॥
en: Said these words: “Do not fight with Bhishma for he is your pupil” and he too said to her who was beseeching him. “Turn back the purpose of Bhishma. I am here because he does not perform what I desire."

sa: तमापृष्ट्वा नरपतिं राजा दशरथस्तदा। मुनीन्द्रौ तौ पुरस्कृत्य जगामाशु महायशाः॥
en: Then having greeted that king of men, the illustrious Dasaratha, placing those foremost of ascetics in his front, went away.

sa: एते गच्छन्ति बहवः पन्थानो दक्षिणापथम्। अवन्तीमृक्षवन्तं च समतिक्रम्य पर्वतम्॥
en: These various roads before you, passing by the (city of) Avanti and crossing the Rikshavat mountain lead to the Deccan.

sa: स्थैर्गजैस्तथा चाश्चर्यानैश्चान्यैरनेकशः। ब्रुवन्तो भीमसेनस्तु यातो ह्यग्रत एव नः॥ ततो दुर्योधनः पापस्तत्रापश्यन् वृकोदरम्। भ्रातृभिः सहितो हृष्टां नगरं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Some on horses, some on elephants and some preferring cars and other conveyances. They said, “Bhima must have gone before us." The wicked Duryodhana was glad not to see Bhima; and we entered the city with his brothers (in joy).

sa: एकाह्वा राजपुत्रीणां चतसृणां महामुने। पाणीन् गृह्णन्तु चत्वारो राजपुत्रा महाबलाः॥
en: On the same day, O mighty Muni, let the four highly powerful princes espouse the hands of the four princesses.

sa: तथान्ये तापसाः सिद्धा रामं वैश्वानरोपमाः। न्यावृता यथान्यायं तर्पयामासुरीश्वरम् ॥
en: In the same way, other ascetics of accomplished purposes, living lives of integrity, duly pleased that lord, Rāma, resembling Vaisvānara.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्तव पुत्रश्च तथा दुःशासनस्य च। उभौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ संग्रामेष्वपलायिनौ॥
en: Your son Lakshmana and the son of Dushasana, both these foremost among men can never fly back from the battle.

sa: सोमतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा तीर्थसेवी नराधिप॥ सोमलोकमवाप्नोति नरो नास्त्यत्र संशयः।
en: O ruler of men, bathing in the Soma Tirtha, the pilgrim goes to the region of Soma without any doubt.

sa: तस्मै शय्यासनं दिव्यं देवाह रत्नभूषितम्॥ स्पास्तरणसंकीर्णं ददुस्ता: परमस्त्रियः। पादशौचं तु कृत्वैव शुकः संध्यामुपास्य च॥ निषसादासने पुण्ये तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्।
en: Then those foremost of beautiful women offered him an excellent seat. Washing his feet and other limbs, Shuka said his evening prayers, sat on that excellent seat, and began to think of the object for which he had come there.

sa: रौद्रेण कच्चिदस्त्रेण रामेण निहतं रणे। द्रक्ष्याम्यल्पेन कालेन रावणं ससुहृज्जनम्॥
en: Shall I not behold soon that Rāvana with his kinsmen has been destroyed in battle by Rāma with terrible weapons?
